summary: 界面支持英文：设置 › 通用「语言」能选跟随系统、简体中文或 English，新装的跟系统，从旧版本升上来的保持中文；启动器、设置的搜索中英文都认，自带的脚本、访达右键、一句话建提醒也说英文了。另外：新插件「保持唤醒」「睡眠关蓝牙」「平滑滚动」「App 快捷键」，插件有了自己的一页「全部插件」，折叠的翻译服务点开才翻、设置里标出免费的服务，截图悬停能认网页里的元素，钉图上的字能直接拖选；刘海岛认得出系统的专注模式（打开、关掉时提示，开着时一直挂着它的图标），提醒在任何专注模式下都只在刘海上挂个图标，刘海岛还多了整点报时、日历的颜色、全屏时藏起这些开关。还有一批小功能：翻译多了 19 种语言、长文分段翻，片段能填空，便签能多选、粘网页转 Markdown，截图能裁剪、带指针，启动器能跑快捷指令，更新能跳过某个版本、在后台下好退出时装。
summaryEn: Now in English: choose System Language, 简体中文 or English in Settings › General › Language. New installs follow the system, and Macs updating from an earlier version stay in Chinese. Search in Launcher and Settings understands both languages, and the built-in scripts, Finder Menu and one-line reminders speak English too. Also: new Keep Awake, Bluetooth Sleep, Smooth Scrolling and App Shortcuts plugins, plugins get their own All Plugins page, collapsed translation services translate only when expanded, free services are marked, screenshot element detection can see inside web pages, you can select text directly on pins. The Notch now recognizes your Focus (a notice when it turns on or off, and its icon stays while it’s on), reminders show only an icon on the Notch during any Focus, and the Notch gains options like an hourly chime, calendar colors and hiding in full screen. Plus smaller additions: 19 more translation languages and long texts translated in parts, fill-in snippets, multi-select and web-to-Markdown pasting in Notes, cropping and the pointer in screenshots, Shortcuts in the Launcher, and updates you can skip or install on quit.

changes.text: 新插件「保持唤醒」（在 设置 › 全部插件 里添加）：菜单栏、主界面、快捷键和启动器（输「awake 2小时」「保持唤醒 到18点」）都能开，可以选屏幕也不熄，也能按时段（比如工作日 9:00–18:00）自动保持唤醒；手动开着时挂在刘海两边，点开能停止；原来自带的 awake 脚本换成了它
changes.textEn: New plugin Keep Awake (add it in Settings › All Plugins): start it from the menu bar, Home, a shortcut or the Launcher (type “awake 2h” or “awake until 18:00”), optionally keep the display on too, or stay awake automatically on a schedule (say, weekdays 9:00–18:00). While it’s on manually it sits beside the Notch, where you can stop it. It replaces the built-in awake script

changes.text: 新插件「睡眠关蓝牙」：合上盖子睡下去时关掉蓝牙，放进包里不会被蓝牙鼠标、键盘弄醒，醒来只打开睡前自己关掉的蓝牙；接着外接显示器时不关，也能改成每次睡眠都关。只在 MacBook 上有，添加时系统会问蓝牙授权
changes.textEn: New plugin Bluetooth Sleep: turns Bluetooth off when you close the lid, so Bluetooth mice and keyboards can’t wake your Mac in a bag, and at wake turns back on only the Bluetooth it turned off. It stays on with an external display connected, or you can have it turn off at every sleep. MacBook only; macOS asks for Bluetooth access when you add it

changes.text: 新插件「平滑滚动」：普通鼠标的滚轮像触控板那样滑着滚，滑多久、拨一格滚多远都能调；鼠标能单独反向（触控板不变）；按住 ⌥ 临时不平滑，按住 ⇧ 左右滚；游戏、虚拟机、远程桌面自动照原样，别的 App 也能加进停用名单。添加时要「辅助功能」授权
changes.textEn: New plugin Smooth Scrolling: an ordinary mouse wheel glides like a trackpad, and you can adjust how long it glides and how far each notch goes. Reverse the mouse on its own (the trackpad stays the same), hold ⌥ to scroll without smoothing or ⇧ to scroll sideways. Games, virtual machines and remote desktops are left alone automatically, and you can add other apps to skip. It needs Accessibility access when you add it

changes.text: 新插件「App 快捷键」：在任何 App 里单独按住 ⌘ 一会儿（键能换成 ⌥ ⌃ ⇧，时长 0.6–2 秒），弹出它菜单里的全部快捷键，按菜单分组；按着它再按别的键照常给 App，点一行直接执行，点一下搜索框能留住、打字搜（中文也认拼音）。也能在快捷键页设一个组合打开。要辅助功能授权
changes.textEn: New plugin App Shortcuts: in any app, hold ⌘ by itself for a moment (or ⌥, ⌃ or ⇧; 0.6–2 seconds, adjustable) to see every shortcut in its menus, grouped by menu. Keep holding it and press a key to use a shortcut as usual, click a row to run it, or click the search field to keep the list open and type to search. You can also set a shortcut to open it in Shortcuts. Needs Accessibility access

changes.text: 插件有了自己的一页：设置侧栏「插件」组第一行「全部插件」，按用途分组、一行一个；没添加的点进去先看能做什么、怎么用、要什么授权再添加。加了却缺授权的插件标「要授权」，它自己那页的「权限」排到最上面；导入设置前会说会添加哪些插件
changes.textEn: Plugins get their own page: All Plugins, the first item in the Plugins section of the Settings sidebar, grouped by purpose with one row per plugin. Click a plugin you haven’t added to see what it does, how to use it, and what access it needs before adding it. Plugins that are missing access are marked “Needs access”, with Permissions at the top of their page, and importing settings tells you which plugins it will add

changes.text: 界面支持英文：菜单栏、主界面、刘海岛、各功能的面板、设置、系统的授权说明和更新日志都有英文。设置 › 通用「语言」能选跟随系统、简体中文或 English，换了之后重新打开 Kitty Tools 生效（那一行有「现在重新打开」）；系统是繁体中文时显示简体
changes.textEn: English interface: the menu bar, Home, the Notch, every feature’s panels, Settings, system permission prompts and the release notes are all available in English. Choose System Language, 简体中文 or English in Settings › General › Language; the change takes effect after Kitty Tools relaunches (the row offers “Relaunch Now”). Systems set to Traditional Chinese show Simplified Chinese

changes.text: 新装的跟系统语言走；从旧版本升上来的保持中文——系统是英文的，第一次打开时替你定成中文，刘海岛上说一声在哪换。新装、系统英文在前时，翻译的第一语言是英语、第二语言是简体中文
changes.textEn: New installs follow the system language. Updating from an earlier version keeps Chinese: on an English system, Kitty Tools sets itself to Chinese the first time it opens and the Notch tells you where to switch. On new installs with English first in the system, Translate’s first language is English and the second is Simplified Chinese

changes.text: 搜索中英文都认：英文界面里打中文名、拼音、首字母照样找得到 App、命令和设置，中文界面里打英文也找得到；设置窗的搜索、快捷键速查表同样
changes.textEn: Search understands both languages: in the English interface you can still find apps, commands and settings by Chinese name, pinyin or initials, and in the Chinese interface by their English names; Settings search and Keyboard Shortcuts work the same way

changes.text: 自带的 8 个脚本有英文的名字和说明，输出跟着界面语言；自己写的脚本能读环境变量 KITTY_LANGUAGE（zh-Hans 或 en），按界面语言说话。计算器的单位、汇率的货币名也跟着界面语言
changes.textEn: The 8 built-in scripts have English names and descriptions, and their output follows the interface language; your own scripts can read the KITTY_LANGUAGE environment variable (zh-Hans or en) to do the same. Calculator units and currency names follow the interface language too

changes.text: 启动器里一句话建提醒也认英文：「remind me in 10 min to stretch」「remind half an hour from now tea」这类写法直接建好（英文暂时只认「多久之后」，不认「哪天几点」）
changes.textEn: One-line reminders in Launcher understand English: phrases like “remind me in 10 min to stretch” or “remind half an hour from now tea” create the reminder right away (English currently understands “in how long”, not a specific day and time)

changes.text: 提醒认专注模式：开着任何专注模式（勿扰、睡眠、工作、自己建的）时，到点的提醒只在刘海上挂个图标，不弹出、不出声，结束后一起弹一次；在 设置 › 提醒 里能改成「先不提醒，结束后再响」或「照常提醒」，也能在系统的专注模式滤镜里给某几个模式另选；要紧的提醒在详情里打开「专注模式时也照常提醒」
changes.textEn: Reminders respect Focus: while any Focus is on (Do Not Disturb, Sleep, Work or one you created), due reminders only show an icon on the Notch, with no pop-up or sound, and appear together when it ends. Change this in Settings › Reminders to “Hold until the Focus ends” or “Remind as usual”, or choose per Focus with the Kitty Tools “Reminders” Focus filter. Turn on “Also remind during Focus” for important ones

changes.text: 刘海上显示专注模式：打开、关掉、换模式时，刘海两边出 2 秒，左边是模式的图标和名字（用模式自己的颜色），右边「开」或「关」；开着的这段时间刘海左边一直有它的图标，点开能去专注模式设置；自己建的模式也认，不要任何授权。设置 › 刘海岛「专注模式」能关，还能打开睡眠模式打开时响一声、专注时把跳动条换成模式的图标、专注时不弹电源和耳机这些系统提示
changes.textEn: Focus on the Notch: when a Focus turns on, off or changes, its icon and name (in its own color) show beside the notch for 2 seconds with On or Off, and while it’s on its icon stays on the left of the notch; click it to open Focus settings. Focuses you created work too, and no permission is needed. In Settings › Notch › Focus you can turn it off, play a sound when Sleep turns on, replace the waveform with the Focus icon, or hold System Notices such as power and headphones during Focus

changes.text: 刘海岛的几样新开关（都默认关）：整点报时、日程开始时响一声（开着专注模式、录屏录音时不响），低电量模式打开或关掉时在刘海上说一声，截图、录屏时不显示刘海岛，给刘海岛描一圈细边（深色桌面上也看得清）
changes.textEn: New Notch options (all off by default): an hourly chime and a sound when an event starts (silent during a Focus or while recording), a notice when Low Power Mode turns on or off, hiding the Notch in screenshots and recordings, and a faint outline that keeps it visible on dark desktops

changes.text: 刘海岛能调的更多了：提示停多久（短、标准、长），停在刘海上多久展开，音量和亮度那一行停多久、细条用强调色、旁边写百分比；电量低时系统算得出就写「还能用约 25 分钟」；正在用放歌的 App 时刘海两边先收起
changes.textEn: More Notch options: how long notices stay (short, standard, long), how long to hover before expanding, how long the volume and brightness bar stays, an accent-colored bar with the percentage next to it; low battery notices say about how many minutes are left when the system knows; and Now Playing hides from the notch while you’re using the app that’s playing

changes.text: 刘海岛上的日程能用日历的颜色，那一张的月历能标出有日程的日子，能选读哪些日历、要不要算拒绝了的日程（都在 设置 › 刘海岛「日程」，默认关）
changes.textEn: Events on the Notch can use their calendar’s color, the month calendar can mark days with events, and you can choose which calendars to read and whether declined events count (Settings › Notch › Events, all off by default)

changes.text: 刘海岛的正在播放能换颜色（封面的颜色、强调色、白色），放「音乐」时播放卡片上一颗心能直接收藏这首；前台 App 全屏时能让刘海岛藏起来（设置 › 刘海岛，默认关）
changes.textEn: Now Playing on the Notch can use the artwork color, the accent color or white, and while Music is playing a heart on the playback card favorites the song; the Notch can also hide while the app in front is full screen (Settings › Notch, off by default)

changes.text: 刘海上提醒的倒数更安静：还剩 10 分钟以上只写分钟「42分」，最后 10 分钟才走秒、最后 1 分钟变成强调色；字小一号，设了图标的提醒左边显示它的图标
changes.textEn: The reminder countdown on the Notch is calmer: with more than 10 minutes left it shows whole minutes (42m), the last 10 minutes tick by the second and the last minute turns the accent color. The text is a size smaller, and reminders with an icon show it on the left

changes.text: 在设置里把提醒的时间调到「现在 + 1 分钟」这类时间时，不再带上当时的秒数：倒数按整分算，到点和菜单栏的钟同时跳
changes.textEn: Times picked in reminder settings no longer carry over the current seconds, so the countdown runs to the whole minute and the reminder fires as the menu bar clock changes

changes.text: 访达右键的菜单跟着 Kitty Tools 的语言；新建的文件按当时的语言起名（文本文件.txt 或 Text File.txt）
changes.textEn: Finder Menu follows Kitty Tools’ language, and new files are named in the language at the time (Text File.txt or 文本文件.txt)

changes.text: 日期和时间跟着界面语言和系统的 12 / 24 小时制显示；导出的设置文件、便签的 Markdown 文件夹按导出时的语言起名，导入时照内容认、不看名字
changes.textEn: Dates and times follow the interface language and the system’s 12- or 24-hour setting; exported settings files and Notes Markdown folders are named in the language at export time, and importing goes by their contents, not their names

changes.text: 折叠着的翻译服务不再自动翻译，点开才翻：不发请求、不耗额度；点开后翻出来的那张不换剪贴板、不另记一条历史
changes.textEn: Collapsed translation services no longer translate on their own and only translate when you expand them, so no requests are sent and no quota is used; a card translated after expanding doesn’t replace the clipboard or add another history entry

changes.text: 设置 › 翻译 标出免费的服务：名字后面一枚「免费」标签，「+」菜单里免费的排在前面
changes.textEn: Settings › Translate marks the free services with a “Free” tag, and the + menu lists them first

changes.text: 悬停识别元素能认网页里的元素：设置 › 截图「也认网页里的元素」（默认关），打开后浏览器和用网页技术做的 App 里也能一块块框出来
changes.textEn: Element detection can see inside web pages: turn on “Also detect elements in web pages” in Settings › Screenshot (off by default) to outline parts of pages in browsers and apps built with web technology

changes.text: 悬停识别元素认得更细：文件名、链接、开关这类小块也能单独框出来；macOS 26 上玻璃工具栏底下的按钮不再认成下面那一行
changes.textEn: Element detection is finer: small items like file names, links and switches can be outlined on their own, and on macOS 26 buttons in the glass toolbar are no longer mistaken for the row underneath

changes.text: 截图翻译把译文盖回截图上时，悬停也能识别窗口里的元素：停在哪块就框出哪块、单击就翻那一块，滚轮换大小、Tab 只认窗口都和截图一样
changes.textEn: When Translate Screenshot puts translations back on the screenshot, hovering detects elements too: the part under the pointer is outlined and a click translates it, and scrolling to resize and Tab for windows only work just as in Take Screenshot

changes.text: 钉图上的字能直接拖选：鼠标停到钉图上就认出图里的字，在字上拖动选字、⌘C 拷贝、⌘A 全选，右键能翻译、用搜索引擎搜、查词典；空白处照旧拖着挪，按住 ⌥ 在哪都能挪。设置 › 截图「钉图上的字可以直接选」（默认开）
changes.textEn: Select text directly on pins: rest the pointer on a pin and its text is recognized, then drag over the text to select it, press ⌘C to copy or ⌘A to select all, and right-click to translate, search the web or look it up. Drag empty areas to move the pin as before, or hold ⌥ to move it from anywhere. Turn it off with “Select text directly on pins” in Settings › Screenshot (on by default)

changes.text: 框选时的操作提示和放大镜能关：设置 › 截图「框选时显示操作提示」，和「框选时的放大镜」（放大镜和色值 / 只显示放大镜 / 不显示）；不显示色值时按 C 不再取色、不结束截图，标注里的吸管照常能取
changes.textEn: Tips and the magnifier while selecting can be turned off: use “Show tips while selecting” and “Magnifier while selecting” (Magnifier and color value, Magnifier only, or Off) in Settings › Screenshot. With the color value hidden, C no longer copies a color or ends the screenshot, and the eyedropper in annotations still works

changes.text: 截图翻译把译文盖回截图上时，英文正文翻成中文按原来的字号排、不再缩得很小，段落的左边和顶边对齐原文；气泡里的标题、正文、角上的小标签和按钮各翻各的，不再接成一段
changes.textEn: When Screenshot Translate writes the translation back onto the screenshot, Chinese text translated from English paragraphs keeps a readable size instead of shrinking, lined up with the original paragraphs; a bubble’s title, body, corner label and button are translated separately instead of running together

changes.text: 鼠标停在按钮上，说明文字大约 0.6 秒就出来（原来要等 1.5 秒左右）
changes.textEn: Tooltips now appear after about 0.6 seconds instead of about 1.5

changes.text: 「压缩时跳过」改成单独一页：node_modules、.git、*.log 这些常见的一项一个开关，另外要跳的一行一条，写错了当场说哪里不对
changes.textEn: Skip When Compressing is now its own page: common items like node_modules, .git and *.log each have a switch, anything else goes one per line, and mistakes are pointed out as you type

changes.text: 访达右键「压缩为」多了 TAR.GZ：Linux 和 Windows 11 不用另装软件就能解开，中文名不乱码，不夹带 Mac 的隐藏文件和扩展属性
changes.textEn: Compress As in Finder Menu adds TAR.GZ: Linux and Windows 11 open it without extra software, Chinese names stay readable, and Mac hidden files and extended attributes are left out

changes.text: 解压时包里只差大小写的两个文件（Readme.md 和 README.md）不再悄悄少一个：两个都留，被盖掉的那个名字加「 2」，刘海岛上说一声
changes.textEn: Extract Here no longer silently loses one of two files whose names differ only in letter case (Readme.md and README.md): both are kept, one gets “ 2” added, and the Notch tells you

changes.text: 压缩时有文件读不到，刘海岛说出是哪个文件（原来笼统地说「没有权限读写这个位置」）
changes.textEn: When a file can’t be read while compressing, the Notch names that file instead of blaming the whole location

changes.text: 包旁边放不下（只读的盘、没有写权限的文件夹）时，刘海岛上能点「放到下载」或「选择位置…」换个地方压缩、解压
changes.textEn: When an archive can’t go next to the files (a read-only disk, or a folder you can’t write to), the Notch offers Put in Downloads or Choose Location… instead

changes.text: 「移动到」「复制到」「剪切 → 粘贴」做完，刘海岛上能撤销：移动的挪回原处、名字不变，复制出来的移到废纸篓
changes.textEn: After Move To, Copy To, or Cut and Paste, you can undo from the Notch: moved items go back where they were under their old names, and copies go to the Trash

changes.text: 设置 › 访达右键 能打开「解压后把压缩包移到废纸篓」（默认关），刘海岛上能一键放回压缩包
changes.textEn: Settings › Finder Menu can move archives to the Trash after extracting (off by default), with Put Back Archive on the Notch

changes.text: 按住 ⌥ 右键压缩包，「解压到这里」换成「解压到…」，自己选解到哪
changes.textEn: Hold ⌥ while right-clicking an archive to get Extract To… and choose where it goes

changes.text: 访达右键多了「拷贝图中文字」：右键图片，把图里的字拷进剪贴板，有二维码就拷它的内容；能一次选好几张，进度条上能停
changes.textEn: Finder Menu adds Copy Text from Image: right-click images to copy the text in them, or a QR code’s content. Works on several images at once, with progress you can stop

changes.text: 访达工具栏能放一个「Kitty Tools」按钮（访达 › 显示 › 自定工具栏…），点开是右键里的这几项；iCloud 云盘（包括同步到 iCloud 的桌面、文稿）和网盘的文件夹里系统不给右键项，用它照样能用，第一次会问要不要让 Kitty Tools 控制访达
changes.textEn: Add a Kitty Tools button to the Finder toolbar (Finder › View › Customize Toolbar…) for the same items as the right-click menu. It also works in iCloud Drive (including a Desktop and Documents synced with iCloud) and cloud storage folders, where macOS doesn’t show right-click items; the first time, macOS asks whether Kitty Tools may control Finder

changes.text: 设置 › 便签「屏幕边缘」的位置改成「左边 | 右边」，和屏幕上的方位一致
changes.textEn: The Position option under Settings › Notes › Screen Edge now reads Left | Right, matching the screen

changes.text: 翻译能选的语言多了 19 种：越南语、泰语、印尼语、马来语、阿拉伯语、土耳其语、印地语、荷兰语、波兰语、乌克兰语、瑞典语、丹麦语、芬兰语、挪威语、捷克语、希腊语、希伯来语、匈牙利语、罗马尼亚语，自动识别、朗读也认得它们
changes.textEn: 19 more translation languages: Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Czech, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian and Romanian, including detection and speech

changes.text: 很长的文字分段翻译：AI 服务（含默认的智谱）一次译不完的长文按段、按句切开依次翻，译文一段段接着出来，不再翻到一半就断
changes.textEn: Long text is translated in parts: when an AI service (including the default Zhipu) can’t finish it in one go, it’s split by paragraph and sentence and the translation keeps flowing instead of stopping halfway

changes.text: 复制带图的富文本（文稿、笔记里图文混排的一段），从历史粘回去时图片还在
changes.textEn: Rich text with images (a mixed passage from a document or note) keeps its images when pasted back from history

changes.text: 暂停记录剪贴板时，菜单栏图标挂一个灰色的暂停角标，免得忘了还在暂停
changes.textEn: While clipboard recording is paused, the menu bar icon shows a gray pause badge so you don’t forget

changes.text: 片段的日期时间能偏移、自定格式：{date+1d}、{date-1w:yyyy/MM/dd}、{time+30m}；{input:称呼} 粘贴前弹框填空，同名的只问一次
changes.textEn: Snippet dates and times can be shifted and formatted: {date+1d}, {date-1w:yyyy/MM/dd}, {time+30m}; {input:Name} asks you to fill it in before pasting, once per name

changes.text: 往便签里粘网页、文稿时保留链接、粗体、斜体、标题、列表和代码（转成 Markdown）；⌥⇧⌘V 粘纯文本
changes.textEn: Pasting web pages or documents into a note keeps links, bold, italics, headings, lists and code as Markdown; ⌥⇧⌘V pastes plain text

changes.text: 快速记一条能贴图：⌘V 贴进来的图排在正文下面，记下时跟着进便签
changes.textEn: Quick Note takes images: images pasted with ⌘V line up below the text and go into the note when you save

changes.text: 全部便签窗口能多选（列表、便签墙都行，⌘A 全选）：整批删除、归档、固定、换色，一次就能撤销；导入一大批之后岛上能整批撤回
changes.textEn: Select several notes in the All Notes window (list or wall, ⌘A selects all) to delete, archive, pin or recolor them together, with a single undo; after a big import you can take it back from the Notch

changes.text: 全部便签能按最近修改排（工具栏「排序」）
changes.textEn: All Notes can be sorted by last modified (Sort in the toolbar)

changes.text: 屏幕边缘的便签有了全局快捷键（在 设置 › 快捷键 里设）：叫出那一列，↑↓ 选、↩ 打开、Esc 收回
changes.textEn: Notes on the screen edge get a global shortcut (set it in Settings › Shortcuts): it brings out the stack; ↑↓ to choose, ↩ to open, Esc to put it away

changes.text: 截完图角落缩略图上能直接「改标注」，改完的回写到截图历史
changes.textEn: Edit Annotations right from the screenshot thumbnail in the corner; the changes go back into Screenshot History

changes.text: 标注里能裁剪（工具栏的裁剪钮或 X）：长截图拼完、在历史里改标注时去掉多余的部分
changes.textEn: Crop while annotating (the crop button or X): trim a scrolling capture or a screenshot you’re editing from history

changes.text: 设置 › 截图 新开关：截图带上鼠标指针、截图录屏时隐藏桌面图标（都默认关）
changes.textEn: New switches in Settings › Screenshot: include the pointer in screenshots, and hide desktop icons when capturing or recording (both off by default)

changes.text: 录屏能选用哪个麦克风（设置 › 录制）；选的那个没接着时这次用系统默认的，并说一声
changes.textEn: Choose which microphone screen recordings use (Settings › Recording); if it isn’t connected, the system default is used and you’re told

changes.text: 启动器能搜索、运行「快捷指令」App 里的快捷指令（设置 › 启动器 能关）
changes.textEn: Search and run your Shortcuts from the Launcher (you can turn this off in Settings › Launcher)

changes.text: 脚本命令的别名和应用别名撞了也会描橙框提醒
changes.textEn: Script command aliases that clash with app aliases are now outlined in orange too

changes.text: 有新版本时能「跳过这个版本」，菜单栏的小圆点和面板底栏的提示就不再挂着；新版本默认在后台下好、退出时装上（设置 › 关于 能关）
changes.textEn: Skip This Version hides the update dot and panel hints until a newer version comes out; new versions now download in the background and install when you quit (you can turn this off in Settings › About)

changes.text: 主界面里直接打字就转到启动器搜索
changes.textEn: Start typing in the Home panel to search in the Launcher

changes.text: 关于页加「反馈问题」：打开 GitHub 新建问题，只预填版本号和系统版本
changes.textEn: Report a Problem on the About page opens a new GitHub issue, prefilled with only the app and system versions

changes.text: 程序坞预览的卡片上能最小化窗口，鼠标中键点卡片关掉那扇窗口
changes.textEn: Dock Preview cards can minimize their window, and a middle click on a card closes it

changes.text: 安装包和更新包小了约 3.7 MB：状态屏、提醒图标格子里的表情，除了自带的状态和示例提醒用的几个，都是第一次用到时才下载动画，没下好、没联网时先显示缩略图。关着「自动下载动画表情」的话，这些表情只显示缩略图、不会动
changes.textEn: The app and its updates are about 3.7 MB smaller: apart from the few used by the built-in statuses and example reminders, the emoji in the status and reminder icon grids download their animation the first time they’re used, showing a thumbnail until then or when you’re offline. With “Download animated emoji automatically” turned off, these emoji show a thumbnail and don’t animate

changes.text: 启动器里的 App 名跟系统语言、和访达里显示的一致，中英文名照样都能搜到
changes.textEn: App names in the Launcher follow the system language and match Finder, and both Chinese and English names are still searchable

changes.text: 开着音量、亮度键的刘海岛提示时，输入中文后按中英文切换键不再闪退
changes.textEn: With volume and brightness keys shown on the Notch, switching input sources after typing Chinese no longer crashes Kitty Tools

changes.text: 用拼音这类先出拼音、再选字的输入法打字时，第一个字母不再丢掉（打 zhe 不再只剩 he）：快速记一条、便签的标题、启动台的搜索框、输入翻译的原文框
changes.textEn: When you type with an input method that shows pinyin before you pick a character, the first letter is no longer lost (typing “zhe” no longer leaves just “he”) in Quick Note, note titles, the Launchpad search field and the Type to Translate box

changes.text: 别的 App 开着安全输入（输入密码时系统会开）时，只带 ⌥ 的快捷键按了没反应、也没有任何提示：现在打开主界面，底下会说是哪个 App 开着安全输入，悬停能看怎么恢复
changes.textEn: When another app has Secure Input on (macOS turns it on while you type a password), shortcuts that use only ⌥ silently stop responding. Home now tells you which app has Secure Input on; hover over the note to see how to get your shortcuts back

changes.text: App 内更新按芯片挑安装包：Intel 版只装 Intel 的包，不会换上打不开的版本
changes.textEn: In-app updates pick the package for your Mac’s chip: Intel builds only install Intel packages, so they never switch to a version that won’t open

changes.text: 数据打不开、选了「重新开始」之后，「从备份恢复」直接选得到之前的设置与数据自动备份，提示里写明是哪天的
changes.textEn: After choosing Start Over when your data can’t be opened, Restore from Backup lists your earlier automatic settings backups right away, and the alert names the date

summary: 新增「插件」：便签、提醒、状态屏等挪进插件，另有新插件刘海岛（正在播放的歌、录屏计时、提醒倒数、下一个日程挂在刘海两边，播放卡片能拖进度、切歌，音量亮度键、电源和耳机的电量也能显示在刘海上）；截图标注能调字号、拖边改大小、真模糊打码、自动盖住手机号邮箱，还有双头箭头和吸管；访达右键能解 RAR、压缩时能跳过指定文件；同步能直接连 WebDAV 服务器；修了输入法打字时提示字不消失、长截图手动滚和框住网页里一小块滚动区时对不上。
summaryEn: New Plugins: Notes, Reminders, Status Screen and more moved into Plugins, plus a new Notch plugin (the song that’s playing, recording timers, reminder countdowns and your next event sit on both sides of the notch; you can scrub and skip tracks on the playback card; volume and brightness keys, power and headphone battery can show on the notch too). Screenshot annotations get adjustable font size, edge handles for resizing, real blur, automatic blurring of phone numbers and email addresses, double-headed arrows and an eyedropper. Finder Menu can extract RAR and skip chosen files when compressing. Sync can connect straight to a WebDAV server. Fixed placeholder text staying visible while typing with an input method, and Scrolling Capture losing track when scrolling by hand or inside a small scrolling area of a web page.

changes.text: 新增「插件」：在 设置 › 通用 › 功能 下面添加、移除，不添加就不出现、不运行。功能只留剪贴板、启动器、翻译、截图、录制五样；便签、提醒、状态屏、启动台、程序坞预览、访达右键改成了插件，原来开着的升级后照旧开着，设置和数据都在。第一次打开时的引导里也能直接勾上要的插件
changes.textEn: New Plugins: add or remove them under Settings › General › Features; a plugin you haven’t added doesn’t appear or run. Features are now just Clipboard, Launcher, Translate, Screenshot and Recording; Notes, Reminders, Status Screen, Launchpad, Dock Preview and Finder Menu became plugins. Ones you had turned on stay on after updating, with their settings and data intact. You can also pick plugins during first-run setup

changes.text: 新插件「刘海岛」（升级上来的默认添加着；岛上弹的提示不归它，一直都在）：录屏、录音时刘海两边挂着计时，点一下展开、能停止（只录麦克风时能暂停）；一小时以内的提醒在刘海上倒数，能提前结束或推后 5 分钟；压缩、拷贝、解压这类超过 3 秒的活缩到刘海两边显示进度；没有刘海的屏挂在菜单栏上
changes.textEn: New Notch plugin (added by default when you update; notices that pop up on the notch don’t belong to it and are always there): while recording the screen or audio, a timer sits on both sides of the notch—click to expand it and stop (you can pause when recording only the microphone); reminders due within an hour count down on the notch, where you can finish them early or snooze them for 5 minutes; compressing, copying, extracting and other tasks longer than 3 seconds shrink to the sides of the notch and show their progress; on displays without a notch they sit in the menu bar

changes.text: 设置 › 刘海岛：点刘海打开的那一张上，快捷动作能逐个关掉、拖动排先后，能列出最近的提示、显示这个月的日历（两样默认都不显示）；装了别的刘海 App 时能关掉「点刘海打开」。指针停在刘海上两指往下滑也能打开；停上去默认只鼓起一点、点了才展开，想要停一下就展开可以打开「停在刘海上自动展开」
changes.textEn: Settings › Notch: on the card that opens when you click the notch, quick actions can be turned off one by one and dragged to reorder, and the card can list recent notices and show this month’s calendar (both hidden by default). If you use another notch app, you can turn off opening on click. With the pointer on the notch, swiping down with two fingers opens it too. Hovering only makes it bulge slightly by default and clicking expands it; turn on “Expand when hovering over the notch” to expand it on hover

changes.text: 系统提示（默认关，设置 › 刘海岛 打开）：接上 / 拔掉电源、电量低、耳机连上时刘海往两边长开几秒，左边一句话、右边电量（蓝牙耳机的电量也有）；断网和网络恢复时弹一下
changes.textEn: System Notices (off by default, turn on in Settings › Notch): when you plug in or unplug power, the battery runs low or headphones connect, the notch widens for a few seconds with a short message on the left and the battery level on the right (Bluetooth headphones included). It also pops up when the network drops and when it comes back

changes.text: 正在播放（默认关，设置 › 刘海岛 打开）：放歌、放视频时刘海两边是封面和跳动条，点开有歌名和进度条——进度条能拖、能点着跳，能暂停、切上一首下一首、换随机和循环、调输出音量，颜色跟着封面走；在刘海上双指左右滑直接切歌，换歌时垂下来显示歌名；点封面切到正在放的 App；「音乐」、Safari、Chrome 里放的都认得
changes.textEn: Now Playing (off by default, turn on in Settings › Notch): while music or video plays, the artwork and a bouncing level meter sit beside the notch. Open it for the title and a progress bar you can drag or click to jump, play/pause, previous/next, shuffle and repeat, and output volume, all tinted to match the artwork. Swipe left or right with two fingers on the notch to change tracks; the title drops down when the track changes. Click the artwork to switch to the app that’s playing. Works with Music, Safari and Chrome

changes.text: 音量键、亮度键的提示能换到刘海上（默认关，设置 › 刘海岛「按音量键、亮度键时显示在刘海上」，要「辅助功能」授权）：按音量、亮度、静音键时刘海往两边长开，显示图标和一根细条，系统自己的那块提示不再出现
changes.textEn: Volume and brightness indicators can move to the notch (off by default; turn on “Show on the notch when you press the volume or brightness keys” in Settings › Notch, which requires Accessibility access): pressing the volume, brightness or mute keys widens the notch with an icon and a thin bar, and the system’s own indicator no longer appears

changes.text: 下一个日程（默认关，设置 › 刘海岛 打开，要「日历」授权）：日程开始前 10 分钟挂在刘海两边倒数，点开有时间和地点，视频会议能一键加入
changes.textEn: Next Event (off by default, turn on in Settings › Notch, requires Calendars access): starting 10 minutes before an event, a countdown sits beside the notch. Open it for the time and location, and join video meetings in one click

changes.text: 刘海两边挂着东西时，点刘海、点耳朵、两指往下滑打开的是同一张卡片，再往下滑轮到下一个；展开和收起的动画重做了，展开的卡片四周会渐渐模糊（设置 › 刘海岛「展开时模糊四周」可关）
changes.textEn: When something sits beside the notch, clicking the notch, clicking either side or swiping down with two fingers opens the same card, and swiping down again moves on to the next one. The expand and collapse animations were redone, and the area around the expanded card gradually blurs (turn off “Blur the surroundings when expanded” in Settings › Notch)

changes.text: 标注的矩形、椭圆、打码、聚光灯四条边的中点也能拖；按住 ⇧ 拖角保持比例，按住 ⌥ 从中心缩放；序号能拖四个角放大缩小、能改编号
changes.textEn: Rectangles, ellipses, blurs and spotlights can also be dragged by the midpoints of their edges; hold ⇧ while dragging a corner to keep the proportions, or ⌥ to resize from the center. Step numbers can be resized by dragging their corners and renumbered

changes.text: 文字能调字号：托盘上的 A− / A+、⌘+ / ⌘−，或者鼠标停在标注上滚滚轮；箭头能选双头；色点后面有吸管，从截图里取色
changes.textEn: Text annotations have an adjustable font size: A− / A+ on the tray, ⌘+ / ⌘−, or scroll while hovering over the annotation. Arrows can be double-headed. An eyedropper after the color dots picks colors from the screenshot

changes.text: 「马赛克」改名「打码」，模糊换成真正的高斯模糊，弱档也认不出字，原来的方块在「像素」里；打码多了「自动」，一下盖住截图里的手机号、邮箱、银行卡号和身份证号
changes.textEn: “Mosaic” is now “Blur” and uses a real Gaussian blur that keeps text unreadable even at the light setting; the old blocks are under “Pixelate”. Blur has a new “Auto” option that covers phone numbers, email addresses, bank card numbers and ID numbers in the screenshot in one go

changes.text: 「解压到这里」支持 RAR（带密码的和分卷的解不了）
changes.textEn: “Extract Here” supports RAR (password-protected and multi-part archives aren’t supported)

changes.text: 压缩时能跳过指定的文件和文件夹，比如 node_modules、.git、*.log：设置 › 访达右键「压缩时跳过」
changes.textEn: Compressing can skip the files and folders you specify, such as node_modules, .git and *.log: Settings › Finder Menu › Skip When Compressing

changes.text: 同步能直接连 WebDAV 服务器（网盘提供的 WebDAV、自己的 NAS）：设置 › 通用「同步」点「连接服务器…」，填地址、用户名和密码，几台电脑不在一个网络里、也不用装网盘客户端就能同步；服务器上的文件和同步文件夹里的一样，另一台用同步盘指到同一个文件夹也合得到一起。连服务器时大约一分钟同步一轮，密码存在钥匙串里
changes.textEn: Sync can connect directly to a WebDAV server (WebDAV from a cloud storage provider, or your own NAS): in Settings › General › Sync, click “Connect to Server…” and enter the address, user name and password. Macs on different networks can sync without installing a cloud drive client. The files on the server are the same as in a Sync Folder, so another Mac pointing a synced drive at the same folder merges too. When connected to a server, sync runs about once a minute, and the password is stored in the keychain

changes.text: 设置 › 剪贴板「图片最多占用」多了 256 MB 一档，想让历史里的图片少占点空间时用；这一行改成了弹出菜单
changes.textEn: Settings › Clipboard › Maximum image storage has a new 256 MB option for when you want images in the history to take up less space; the row is now a pop-up menu

changes.text: 主界面重新分了组：添加了的插件收进最后一节「插件」；只放点一下就用的动作，「暂停记录剪贴板」「复制即译」两个开关和「钉住剪贴板内容」不再占格子，在右键菜单和启动器里照旧
changes.textEn: Home is regrouped: plugins you’ve added go in a final Plugins section. Home now holds only one-click actions—the “Pause Clipboard Recording” and “Translate on Copy” switches and “Pin Clipboard Content” no longer take up tiles, and are still in the right-click menu and Launcher

changes.text: 长截图选区很大时，用触控板快速往下滑不再常常提示「对不上了」
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture with a very large selection no longer keeps saying it lost track when you swipe down quickly on the trackpad

changes.text: 长截图框住网页里一小块会自己滚的区域（对话记录、代码框）时，不再一直提示「对不上了」；自动滚动会把光标挪进那一块
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture no longer keeps saying it lost track when the selection covers a small area of a web page that scrolls on its own (a chat log, a code block); auto-scroll moves the pointer into that area

changes.text: 从启动器、启动台、访达右键打开的 App 拿到的环境和从访达打开时一样：应用内更新之后，从启动器打开的 JetBrains IDE 找不到终端里配的命令（如 /opt/homebrew/bin 下的）的问题修好了
changes.textEn: Apps opened from Launcher, Launchpad and Finder Menu get the same environment as when opened from Finder: after an in-app update, JetBrains IDEs opened from Launcher can find commands set up in Terminal again (such as those in /opt/homebrew/bin)

changes.text: 用拼音这类输入法打字、还没选字时，输入框里的灰色提示字不再和拼音叠在一起（翻译原文框、快速记一条、便签的标题和正文、启动台的搜索框）
changes.textEn: When you type with an input method such as Pinyin and haven’t chosen a character yet, the gray placeholder text no longer overlaps what you’re typing (the translation source field, Quick Note, note titles and text, and the Launchpad search field)

changes.text: macOS 26 上按新的系统设置判断系统的应用程序捏合开没开；设置 › 启动台 和刘海岛上给一条「复制命令」，在终端里运行就能关掉系统的捏合
changes.textEn: On macOS 26, whether the system’s app pinch gesture is on is read from the new system setting; Settings › Launchpad and the notch offer a “Copy Command” that turns off the system pinch when you run it in Terminal

changes.text: macOS 26 上关掉设置窗口后，捏合打开的启动台不能直接打字、按 Esc 没反应：现在程序坞里一直留着 Kitty Tools 的图标，不想要可以在 设置 › 通用「在程序坞显示图标」关掉（关掉会回到原来的问题）
changes.textEn: On macOS 26, after you closed the Settings window, Launchpad opened by pinching couldn’t take typing and ignored Esc. Kitty Tools now keeps its icon in the Dock; if you don’t want it, turn off “Show icon in Dock” in Settings › General (which brings the problem back)

changes.text: 屏幕上是开孔的新款 MacBook Pro（开孔周围是系统自己的灵动岛）上，提示改在菜单栏下方显示，不再和系统的灵动岛叠在一起
changes.textEn: On the newer MacBook Pro with a camera cutout in the screen (surrounded by the system’s own island), notices now appear below the menu bar instead of overlapping the system’s island

summary: 启动器和启动台会按你的使用习惯排 App：同一个字选过一次，下次就排第一；截图工具栏、尺寸框在亮的页面上不再几乎透明、看不清；尺寸框尽量放在选区外面，不挡住要截的内容；能给 App 起别名，iPad App 也能用中文名搜到；快捷键能在指定的 App 里停用、把按键让给它；屏幕边缘的便签在两块屏时也放在选的那一边；检查更新不再常被 GitHub 限流挡住。
summaryEn: Launcher and Launchpad rank apps by how you use them: pick an app once for what you typed and it comes first next time. The screenshot toolbar and size label are no longer nearly transparent and hard to read on bright pages, and the size label stays outside the selection when it can, so it doesn’t cover what you’re capturing. Apps can have aliases, and iPad apps can be found by their Chinese names too. Shortcuts can be turned off in specific apps, handing the keys to them. Notes on the screen edge stay on the chosen side with two displays. Checking for updates is no longer often blocked by GitHub’s rate limit.

changes.text: 启动器和启动台按使用习惯排 App：在同一个输入下选过一次就排到第一（输 s 选过的，下次输 s 就是它），记得 4 周；在更长的输入下选过的（如 sha），输它的开头时也往前排；启动台的搜索和启动器学同一份记录；还没用过时按系统记的使用排，常用的在前
changes.textEn: Launcher and Launchpad rank apps by how you use them: pick something once for what you typed and it comes first for that next time (type s and pick an app, and next time s brings it up first), remembered for 4 weeks. Picks made with longer input (like sha) also move up when you type its beginning. Launchpad search learns from the same history as Launcher. Before you’ve used them, apps are ordered by the system’s usage records, most used first

changes.text: 能给 App 起别名：设置 › 启动器 › 应用别名，输完整的别名时它排第一，App 更新或挪位置后照样认，跟着设置导出、导入和同步；在 Mac 上装的 iPad App（如美区的小红书 rednote）也能用中文名、拼音和首字母搜到，启动台同样
changes.textEn: Apps can have aliases: in Settings › Launcher › App Aliases, typing the full alias puts the app first, and it still works after the app updates or moves. Aliases follow settings export, import and sync. iPad apps installed on a Mac (such as rednote from the US store) can be found by their Chinese names, pinyin and initials, in Launchpad too

changes.text: 快捷键能在指定的 App 里停用：设置 › 快捷键 最下面加 App，它在前台时快捷键不响应、按键交给它；可以只停其中几个；也能在那个 App 里右键点菜单栏图标直接停用
changes.textEn: Shortcuts can be turned off in specific apps: add apps at the bottom of Settings › Shortcuts, and while one of them is in front the shortcuts don’t respond and the keys go to it. You can turn off just some of them, or right-click the menu bar icon while in that app to turn them off right there

changes.text: 系统设置 › 外观 › 液态玻璃选「透明」时，截图工具栏、样式栏、尺寸框、录屏的录制条、钉图上的按钮、长截图面板压在亮的页面上几乎透明、看不清（开着「框选时保持屏幕原色」或截整屏时最明显）；现在一律是深色底
changes.textEn: With System Settings › Appearance › Liquid Glass set to “Clear”, the screenshot toolbar, style bar, size label, screen recording bar, buttons on pinned screenshots and the Scrolling Capture panel were nearly transparent and hard to read over bright pages (most noticeable with “Keep screen colors while selecting” on or when capturing the full screen); they now always have a dark background

changes.text: 尺寸框上面放不下时先放到选区右侧、左侧或下方，外面都放不下才放进选区，不再挡住要截的内容
changes.textEn: When there’s no room above the selection, the size label goes to its right, left or below it first, and only moves inside the selection when there’s no room outside, so it no longer covers what you’re capturing

changes.text: 截图翻译把译文盖回截图上时，有序列表（尤其「1.」后面没有空格的）不再并成一段挤在一行，列表后面的正文也单独一段；只有一行的标题、标签右边有空白时照原来的字号排，不再先缩小；选中的按钮里的字不再排到按钮外面、按钮周围不再晕开一圈颜色
changes.textEn: When Translate Screenshot puts translations back on the screenshot, numbered lists (especially with no space after “1.”) are no longer merged into one crowded line, and text after a list gets its own paragraph. Single-line headings and labels with empty space to their right keep their original size instead of shrinking first. Text in selected buttons no longer spills outside the button, and buttons no longer get a halo of color

changes.text: 屏幕边缘的便签选了左边就放在左边：外接屏当主显示器、笔记本在它左边时，主显示器上那叠原来跑到右边（和另一块屏相接的那条边原来不放、自动换到另一侧）
changes.textEn: Notes on the screen edge stay on the left when you choose left: with an external display as the main display and a laptop to its left, the stack on the main display used to jump to the right (the edge shared with another display was avoided and the stack switched sides automatically)

changes.text: 公司、学校这类很多人共用一个出口的网络里，检查更新常报「GitHub 返回 403」（GitHub 按网络限次数）：现在先读新版本附带的一个小文件，不占这个次数；真被限流时说清楚，指到发布页手动下载。下载的更新包另核一遍校验值
changes.textEn: On networks where many people share one connection, such as at work or school, checking for updates often failed with “GitHub returned 403” (GitHub limits requests per network). It now first reads a small file published with each new version, which doesn’t count toward that limit; when you are rate-limited, it says so and points you to the release page to download manually. Downloaded updates are also checked against a checksum

summary: 新增「提醒」：到点挂在刘海岛上，能全屏、闪边框、读出来、一直催；启动器能跑自己的脚本，自带 9 个，每条命令能设快捷键；访达右键能压缩解压、移动复制、新建文件（默认关）；截图框选能识别窗口里的元素，截图翻译盖回时放不下的进卡片；翻译多了两个不用密钥的服务；快捷键能连按两下修饰键，截图时的快捷键能自己改；⌘Tab 也弹窗口预览；第一次打开先挑要用的功能。
summaryEn: New Reminders: they appear on the Notch when due and can go full screen, flash the screen border, be read aloud and keep nagging. Launcher can run your own scripts, with 9 included, and each command can have a shortcut. Finder Menu can compress and extract, move and copy, and create new files (off by default). Screenshot selection can detect elements inside windows, and Translate Screenshot puts what doesn’t fit into cards. Translate gains two services that need no key. A shortcut can be a double press of a modifier key, and screenshot shortcuts can be changed. ⌘Tab shows window previews too. On first launch you pick the features you want.

changes.text: 新功能「提醒」：设好时间，到点挂在刘海岛上，点「知道了」或「稍后」；能只响一次，也能每天、工作日、每周、每月或隔一段时间重复；每条可以选全屏、闪屏幕边框、读出来，也能到点直接进入状态屏
changes.textEn: New feature Reminders: set a time and it appears on the Notch when due, with “Got It” or “Snooze”. It can ring once or repeat daily, on weekdays, weekly, monthly or at an interval. Each reminder can go full screen, flash the screen border, be read aloud, or go straight into Status Screen when due

changes.text: 在启动器里一句话建提醒：输「remind 10分钟 喝水」「提醒 明天9点 交周报」直接建好；菜单栏和主界面有「新提醒」，也能设快捷键；开着同步时提醒跟着同步
changes.textEn: Create a reminder in one line from Launcher: type something like “remind 10 min drink water” and it’s created right away. The menu bar and Home have “New Reminder”, which can also have a shortcut. Reminders sync when Sync is on

changes.text: 提示音能选系统声音、「声音」文件夹里自己放的声音或任意音频文件；没理会时再催，间隔能自己定（1–120 分钟），第 3 次换成全屏
changes.textEn: The alert sound can be a system sound, a sound you put in the Sounds folder, or any audio file. If you don’t respond, it reminds you again at an interval you choose (1–120 minutes), and the third time goes full screen

changes.text: 脚本命令：脚本文件夹里的每个脚本就是启动器里的一条命令，能带参数（下拉选项、密码）、把结果拷贝、粘贴、显示全文（边跑边显示、认终端颜色、⌘R 重跑）或列成一张能打开网址和文件的列表
changes.textEn: Script Commands: each script in the scripts folder is a command in Launcher. Scripts can take arguments (drop-down options, passwords) and copy or paste the result, show the full output (live as it runs, with terminal colors, ⌘R to rerun), or show it as a list of URLs and files you can open

changes.text: 自带 9 个脚本（Unix 时间戳、Base64、URL 编解码、JSON 格式化、进制转换、正则测试、UUID、切换深色模式、防止睡眠），能关、能复制一份出来改；设置 › 启动器 里有「怎么写脚本」和给 AI 的写法说明，复制 AI 写好的脚本点「从剪贴板新建」就能用；⌘K 能编辑、在访达中显示、看出错时的输出
changes.textEn: 9 built-in scripts (Unix timestamp, Base64, URL encode/decode, JSON formatting, number base conversion, regex testing, UUID, toggle Dark Mode, prevent sleep) that you can turn off, or duplicate and edit. Settings › Launcher has “How to Write Scripts” and a guide to give an AI—copy the script the AI wrote and click “New from Clipboard” to use it. ⌘K lets you edit a script, show it in Finder, or see its output when it fails

changes.text: 设置 › 启动器 › 命令和别名：内置命令和脚本都能改要打的词、关掉不用的，每条命令还能设一个快捷键直接运行；提醒和汇率的默认别名改成英文 remind、currency
changes.textEn: Settings › Launcher › Commands & Aliases: change what you type for built-in commands and scripts, turn off the ones you don’t use, and give each command a shortcut that runs it directly. The default aliases for reminders and currency are now the English remind and currency

changes.text: 新功能「访达右键」（默认关，设置 › 访达右键 打开）：在访达里右键能拷贝路径和名称、用指定 App 打开、新建文件（文本、Markdown、文档、表格、演示文稿，或者用剪贴板里的文字、图片新建）、移动 / 复制到常用文件夹、剪切粘贴、做替身，可以收进一个子菜单
changes.textEn: New feature Finder Menu (off by default, turn on in Settings › Finder Menu): right-click in Finder to copy paths and names, open with a chosen app, create new files (text, Markdown, document, spreadsheet, presentation, or from text or an image on the clipboard), move or copy to favorite folders, cut and paste, and make aliases. The items can be grouped into a submenu

changes.text: 右键压缩成 zip / 7z、解压到这里（zip、7z、tar、gz、bz2 等，带密码的会问密码），刘海岛上有进度条、能停；修复从别的电脑拷来的乱码文件名，拷贝 SHA-256 / MD5 / SHA-1（剪贴板里有校验值时顺带比一下），切换隐藏文件、隐藏扩展名、彻底删除
changes.textEn: Right-click to compress to zip / 7z or extract here (zip, 7z, tar, gz, bz2 and more; asks for the password when there is one), with a progress bar on the Notch that you can stop. You can also fix garbled filenames from other computers, copy SHA-256 / MD5 / SHA-1 (compared with a checksum on the clipboard if there is one), toggle hidden files, hide extensions, and delete permanently

changes.text: 框选时悬停能识别窗口里的元素（按钮、输入框、侧栏这类），滚轮往里钻或退出来，程序坞和菜单栏也能悬停截取；默认关，在 设置 › 截图 打开
changes.textEn: While selecting, hovering can detect elements inside windows (buttons, text fields, sidebars and the like); scroll to drill in or back out. The Dock and menu bar can be captured by hovering too. Off by default; turn it on in Settings › Screenshot

changes.text: 截图时的快捷键能自己改：在截图工具栏上右键那颗钮就能换它的键，设置 › 快捷键 里也能改，一共 21 个
changes.textEn: Screenshot shortcuts can be changed: right-click a button on the screenshot toolbar to change its key, or change them in Settings › Shortcuts—21 in all

changes.text: 长截图自动滚动能调速度，滚得匀速顺滑
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture’s auto-scroll speed is adjustable, and it scrolls smoothly at a steady pace

changes.text: 截图工具栏默认贴在选区右边，设置 › 截图 里能换回居中
changes.textEn: The screenshot toolbar now sits to the right of the selection by default; you can switch back to centered in Settings › Screenshot

changes.text: 长截图选区很大时，自动滚动不再反复「对不上」
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture with a very large selection no longer keeps losing track while auto-scrolling

changes.text: 截图翻译盖回截图上时，放不下的段放进选区旁的译文卡片，小选区的字不再缩成看不清的小字；翻完总挂一个窄栏，能看原文、拷全部译文
changes.textEn: When Translate Screenshot puts translations back on the screenshot, paragraphs that don’t fit go into translation cards next to the selection, so text in small selections no longer shrinks to an unreadable size. After translating, a narrow bar always stays, where you can see the original and copy all translations

changes.text: 截图翻译同时翻 3 段，段多时刘海岛上有进度
changes.textEn: Translate Screenshot translates 3 paragraphs at a time and shows progress on the Notch when there are many

changes.text: 截图翻译盖回时不再擦掉图标、不叠字、不把一个词拆开；侧栏、标题各成一段；翻完再框别处，上次的译文不再留在屏幕上
changes.textEn: When putting translations back, Translate Screenshot no longer erases icons, overlaps text or splits words; sidebars and headings become paragraphs of their own. Selecting somewhere else after translating no longer leaves the previous translations on screen

changes.text: 新增两个不用密钥的服务：系统翻译和有道词典；查英文单词时放真人发音，卡片上的喇叭只读译文
changes.textEn: Two new services that need no key: system translation and Youdao Dictionary. Looking up an English word plays a real human pronunciation, and the speaker on the card reads only the translation

changes.text: 快捷键能设成连按两下 ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ 中的一个（要「辅助功能」授权）
changes.textEn: A shortcut can be a double press of one of ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ (requires Accessibility access)

changes.text: 按 ⌘Tab 切换时也弹窗口预览；鼠标停多久再弹能在设置里改（默认 0.4 秒）
changes.textEn: Window previews also appear when switching with ⌘Tab; how long the pointer rests before they appear can be changed in Settings (0.4 seconds by default)

changes.text: 全屏的浏览器在预览里不再多出两个附属窗口
changes.textEn: Full-screen browsers no longer show two extra helper windows in the preview

changes.text: 剪贴板面板和启动器能选出现在哪：屏幕上方、跟随鼠标或上次拖到的地方
changes.textEn: You can choose where the Clipboard panel and Launcher open: at the top of the screen, near the pointer, or where you last dragged them

changes.text: 状态屏和提醒的图标能挑任意系统表情，有动画版的第一次用到时联网下载（一个约 0.2 MB）；自带的动画表情多了 12 个
changes.textEn: Status Screen and reminder icons can be any system emoji; animated versions download the first time you use them (about 0.2 MB each). 12 more animated emoji are built in

changes.text: 第一次打开时先挑要用的功能，授权那一屏只问挑了的功能要的；新装默认只开剪贴板、启动器、翻译、截图四样，别的在 设置 › 通用 › 功能 里随时打开
changes.textEn: On first launch you pick the features you want, and the permissions screen only asks for what those features need. New installs turn on only Clipboard, Launcher, Translate and Screenshot; turn on the rest anytime in Settings › General › Features

changes.text: 设置侧栏的功能分组加了小标题，点标题能收起；网页搜索和通用里的功能开关收成一行，点进去编辑
changes.textEn: Feature groups in the Settings sidebar have headings you can click to collapse. Web Search and the feature switches in General are condensed into a single row each; click it to edit

summary: 截图可以拷贝成 PNG 文件，两台电脑共用剪贴板时也传得过去；框选时可以不压暗、不染色；打开设置 › 关于不再卡一下，浏览器里删掉的书签在启动器里也搜不到了；截图翻译盖回截图上时排得更像原文；程序坞预览不再偶尔闪退。
summaryEn: Screenshots can be copied as PNG files, so they get through when two computers share a clipboard. Selecting can leave the screen undimmed and untinted. Opening Settings › About no longer stalls, and bookmarks deleted in the browser no longer show up in Launcher. Translations put back on screenshots look more like the original. Dock Preview no longer occasionally crashes.

changes.text: 设置 › 截图 新增「截图拷贝为」：选「PNG 文件」后，截图、长截图、钉图、截图历史的拷贝放进剪贴板的是一个图片文件，能粘进文件夹和聊天窗口；用 USB 对拷线这类只传文字和文件的工具在两台电脑间共用剪贴板时，截图也传得过去
changes.textEn: New “Copy screenshots as” in Settings › Screenshot: with “PNG File”, copying a screenshot, scrolling capture, pinned screenshot or Screenshot History item puts an image file on the clipboard that you can paste into folders and chat windows. Screenshots also get through when two computers share a clipboard with tools that only carry text and files, such as a USB transfer cable

changes.text: 设置 › 截图 新增「框选时保持屏幕原色」：打开后框选时不压暗屏幕，悬停的窗口只描边、不染色，放大镜正中的像素也是原色，取色、对比颜色更准
changes.textEn: New “Keep screen colors while selecting” in Settings › Screenshot: when on, the screen isn’t dimmed while you select, the hovered window gets only an outline without a tint, and the center pixel of the magnifier shows the true color, so picking and comparing colors is more accurate

changes.text: 关于页的更新日志只展开当前版本，其他版本折叠成一行、点一下才展开；打开关于页不再卡一下
changes.textEn: The release notes on the About page expand only the current version; other versions collapse to a single line and expand when clicked. Opening the About page no longer stalls

changes.text: 鼠标在程序坞上快速划过时偶尔闪退
changes.textEn: Fixed an occasional crash when the pointer moved quickly across the Dock

changes.text: 在启动器里打开过的书签，在浏览器里删掉后不再以「用过的网址」被搜到，也不再列在「常用」里；删掉的快捷链接同样不再出现
changes.textEn: Bookmarks you opened from Launcher no longer show up as “recently used URLs” or in “Frequent” after you delete them in the browser; deleted Quicklinks no longer appear either

changes.text: 截图翻译「把译文直接盖回截图上」排得更像原文：只去掉原来的字、底色和渐变留着，译文用原文的字色、落在原来的行上；一行里被行内代码块隔开的字接回一句，列表项各盖各的、记号留着；行内代码块跟着译文里的词走，在新位置画底框
changes.textEn: Translate Screenshot’s “Put translations right on the screenshot” looks more like the original: only the original text is removed while backgrounds and gradients stay, and translations use the original text color on the original lines. Text in a line split by inline code is joined back into one sentence, list items are covered one by one and keep their markers, and inline code follows its word in the translation, with its background drawn in the new place

changes.text: 识字时，一行里被行内代码块、项目符号隔开的字接回同一行；以列表记号开头的行另起一段
changes.textEn: When capturing text, words in a line separated by inline code or bullets are joined back into the same line, and lines starting with a list marker begin a new paragraph

summary: 0.7.1 之后的小版本：修好钉图在非 Retina 外接屏上一钉就闪退的问题，系统词典的释义排得更清楚；启动器能直接换算汇率，启动器、剪贴板、翻译浮窗能拖边改大小，设置侧栏分了组、关掉的功能收在底下，截图翻译可以把译文直接盖回截图上，启动器可以只留一个搜索框，剪贴板里的文字也能钉到屏幕上。
summaryEn: A small update after 0.7.1: fixed pinned screenshots crashing as soon as you pinned on a non-Retina external display, and system dictionary definitions are laid out more clearly. Launcher converts currencies directly; Launcher, Clipboard and the translation window can be resized by dragging their edges; the Settings sidebar is grouped, with features you turned off at the bottom; Translate Screenshot can put translations right on the screenshot; Launcher can show just a search field; and text from the clipboard can be pinned to the screen too.

changes.text: 在非 Retina 的外接屏（1x）上点「钉到屏幕」不再闪退；钉图悬停时右上角的按钮和缩放百分比在这类屏上也摆得对
changes.textEn: Clicking “Pin to Screen” on a non-Retina (1x) external display no longer crashes; the buttons in the top-right corner and the zoom percentage of a hovered pinned screenshot are placed correctly on these displays too

changes.text: 查单个词时，系统词典里的双语词典（如牛津英汉汉英）按词性、义项、例句分好行，不再整段铺出来；读音分英音和美音
changes.textEn: When looking up a single word, bilingual dictionaries in the system dictionary (such as Oxford English–Chinese) are split into lines by part of speech, sense and example instead of one long paragraph; pronunciations are split into British and American

changes.text: 启动器、剪贴板面板、翻译浮窗都能拖左右两边改宽度、拖下边改高度，下次打开照这个大小；各自的设置页里能「恢复默认大小」
changes.textEn: Launcher, the Clipboard panel and the translation window can be widened by dragging their left or right edge and made taller by dragging the bottom edge, and open at that size next time; each settings page has “Restore Default Size”

changes.text: 设置 › 翻译 新增「截图翻译时把译文直接盖回截图上」：打开后截图翻译和截图工具栏的「翻译」都留在截图页里，译文按原来的位置盖回图上，可以接着标注、复制、保存；默认关，照旧在翻译浮窗里看
changes.textEn: New “Put translations right on the screenshot” in Settings › Translate: when on, Translate Screenshot and the screenshot toolbar’s “Translate” stay on the screenshot and put the translations back where the text was, so you can keep annotating, copy or save. Off by default, showing results in the translation window as before

changes.text: 计算器能换算汇率：输「100 usd」「100美元转人民币」「100万日元」直接出结果，打到一半（「100 美元 转 英」）时列出货币候选；汇率要联网取，断网时用上次存着的
changes.textEn: The calculator converts currencies: type “100 usd” (or Chinese such as “100美元转人民币”) to get the result right away, and while you’re still typing it lists matching currencies. Exchange rates come from the internet; offline, the last saved rates are used

changes.text: 关键词提示认中文：输「端口」「汇率」这类中文也能找到对应的指令
changes.textEn: Keyword hints understand Chinese: typing Chinese such as “端口” or “汇率” finds the matching commands too

changes.text: 设置 › 启动器 新增「空搜索框里列出常用」：关掉后打开启动器只有搜索框（有收藏时只列收藏），打字才出结果；排序照样按用过的学
changes.textEn: New “Show frequently used items in an empty search field” in Settings › Launcher: when off, Launcher opens with just a search field (only your favorites if you have any), and results appear as you type; ranking still learns from what you use

changes.text: 「钉住剪贴板内容」：剪贴板里是文字时，把文字排成一张卡片钉到屏幕上，能拖、缩放、调透明度、识字、翻译
changes.textEn: “Pin Clipboard Content”: when the clipboard holds text, it’s laid out on a card pinned to the screen that you can drag, zoom, make transparent, capture text from and translate

changes.text: 剪贴板历史里的文字条目也能「钉到屏幕」（⌘K 或右键），选几条会依次错开钉上去
changes.textEn: Text items in Clipboard History can be pinned to the screen too (⌘K or right-click); select several and they’re pinned one after another, slightly offset

changes.text: 设置侧栏分成几组，点组名能收起；关掉的功能挪到最底下的「已关闭」，默认收起
changes.textEn: The Settings sidebar is split into groups you can collapse by clicking the group name; features you turned off move to an “Off” group at the bottom, collapsed by default

changes.text: 从旧版本升上来后，这一版新加的功能在菜单、主界面、设置侧栏和设置页里那一行挂一个「新」；用过一次、升到下一版或 30 天后自己消失
changes.textEn: After updating from an older version, features new in this version get a “New” tag in the menu, Home, the Settings sidebar and their row in Settings; it disappears once you use it, when you update to the next version, or after 30 days

summary: 0.7.0 之后的一轮体检，以修问题为主，改了 30 多处：剪贴板改短保留期会先问、闪退后也按设置清空，截图历史里存的图也打上了马赛克，长截图钉出来不再被压扁，翻译遇到问句只翻不答，快速记一条的草稿退出后还在，空白便签不再越攒越多，第一次打开时授权后重开引导能接着走，检查更新只看 Mac 版。启动台在 App 多的电脑上打开更快、更省内存。
summaryEn: A checkup after 0.7.0, mostly fixes—more than 30 of them: shortening the Clipboard retention period asks first, and history is cleared as set even after a crash; screenshots saved in Screenshot History are blurred too; pinned scrolling captures are no longer squashed; Translate translates questions instead of answering them; Quick Note drafts survive quitting; empty notes no longer pile up; after allowing access on first launch, setup continues when the app reopens; and checking for updates looks only at Mac versions. Launchpad opens faster and uses less memory on Macs with many apps.

changes.text: 设置里把「保留普通历史」改短、或把「图片最多占用」改小，会删掉东西时先问一句，取消就不改
changes.textEn: Shortening “Keep regular history” or lowering “Maximum image storage” in Settings asks first when it would delete items, and nothing changes if you cancel

changes.text: 开着「退出时清空普通历史」时，App 闪退或被强制退出后下次打开也会清掉；删掉、清空的内容不再留在数据文件里
changes.textEn: With “Clear regular history when quitting” on, history is also cleared the next time the app opens after it crashed or was force quit; deleted and cleared items no longer linger in the data file

changes.text: 另一台 Mac 同步来的收藏和片段排在历史末尾，⌘1 粘出来的还是刚复制的那条；复制图片后马上复制文字，顺序不再颠倒
changes.textEn: Favorites and Snippets synced from another Mac are placed at the end of the history, so ⌘1 still pastes what you just copied; copying text right after an image no longer reverses their order

changes.text: 设置页开着时另一台改了「不记录这些 App」，这里再加一个不会把那边加的盖掉；面板固定着时删掉的条目闲两分钟就落下来，同步不再一直停着
changes.textEn: If another Mac changed “Don’t record these apps” while Settings was open, adding one here no longer overwrites what was added there; items deleted while the panel is pinned are removed after two idle minutes, so sync no longer stays paused

changes.text: 「不记录疑似密钥」多认几种常见的开发者密钥
changes.textEn: “Don’t record likely secrets” recognizes more kinds of common developer keys

changes.text: 从截图历史或晾衣绳钉长截图不再被压扁；当初截图的那块屏不在了，钉到现在这块屏的中央
changes.textEn: Scrolling captures pinned from Screenshot History or the Clothesline are no longer squashed; if the display it was captured on is gone, it’s pinned in the center of the current display

changes.text: 打了马赛克的截图，截图历史里存的那张也打上码，回头改标注时删不掉它
changes.textEn: For screenshots with blurred areas, the copy saved in Screenshot History is blurred too, and editing the annotations later can’t remove it

changes.text: 截屏没有响应时等 5 秒就提示，不再让截图快捷键一直没反应；存到「桌面」被拒后，提示里带「打开系统设置」和「更改保存位置」
changes.textEn: When the screen capture doesn’t respond, you’re told after 5 seconds instead of the screenshot shortcut just doing nothing; when saving to the Desktop is denied, the notice offers “Open System Settings” and “Change Save Location”

changes.text: 截图历史改短保留天数、改小占用前先问一句，过了午夜也会按设置清理
changes.textEn: Shortening the retention period or lowering the storage limit of Screenshot History asks first, and cleanup also runs as set after midnight

changes.text: 录屏的「转成 GIF」「压缩」在截图历史和晾衣绳里也能用，录制条目多了「拷贝」；压缩到一半退出不再留下打不开的文件
changes.textEn: “Convert to GIF” and “Compress” for screen recordings also work in Screenshot History and the Clothesline, and recording items gain “Copy”; quitting halfway through compressing no longer leaves a file that won’t open

changes.text: 长图拼得比一屏长时，按一下 Esc 先提示，再按一次才放弃
changes.textEn: When the scrolling capture is longer than a screen, pressing Esc first shows a warning, and pressing it again discards it

changes.text: 长截图画面不动时少占 CPU；存大图不再卡住界面；拷贝过的截图不再在临时文件夹里越积越多
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture uses less CPU when the picture isn’t moving; saving large images no longer freezes the interface; copied screenshots no longer pile up in the temporary folder

changes.text: 原文是一句问话或指令时，只翻译、不去回答它
changes.textEn: When the source text is a question or an instruction, it’s only translated, not answered

changes.text: 两三个词的短语（比如 Sign in）按普通翻译出，能替换原文；从 iPhone 复制的文字不再在 Mac 上弹复制即译
changes.textEn: Phrases of two or three words (like Sign in) get a regular translation and can replace the original; text copied on iPhone no longer triggers Translate on Copy on the Mac

changes.text: 改好服务设置后点「重试」用的是新设置；没填 API Key 的服务在设置里直接标出来；划词翻译并替换遇到一个服务失败会换下一个
changes.textEn: After you change a service’s settings, “Retry” uses the new settings; services without an API key are marked in Settings; when one service fails, Translate and Replace Selection moves on to the next

changes.text: 用 VoiceOver 时，翻译结果出来会读出来，卡片上的按钮带上服务名
changes.textEn: With VoiceOver, translation results are read aloud when they appear, and the buttons on the card include the service name

changes.text: 在同一个词下选过的 App 排在最前（输 ip、gh 不再先出地址或搜索）；「钥匙串访问」「无线诊断」这些系统工具能搜到；只输一个汉字也搜书签
changes.textEn: Apps you picked for the same input come first (typing ip or gh no longer shows an address or a search first); system utilities such as Keychain Access and Wireless Diagnostics can be found; typing a single Chinese character also searches bookmarks

changes.text: 在中国大陆，没有结果时按 ↩ 默认用百度搜（改过搜索列表的不变）
changes.textEn: In mainland China, pressing ↩ when there are no results searches with Baidu by default (unless you changed the search list)

changes.text: 快速记一条写的字，退出或更新之后都还在；按 Esc 清掉后几秒内能「恢复」
changes.textEn: Text typed in Quick Note survives quitting and updating; after clearing it with Esc, you can “Restore” it for a few seconds

changes.text: 新建了没写字的便签，关掉就没了，不再越攒越多
changes.textEn: A new note you didn’t type anything in disappears when you close it, so empty notes no longer pile up

changes.text: 拔掉外接屏后浮动便签挪到主屏，插回来回到原处；同步文件夹里已经没人用的旧图片会清掉
changes.textEn: When you unplug an external display, Floating Notes move to the main display and return when it’s plugged back in; old images no one uses anymore are cleaned out of the Sync Folder

changes.text: 导出的 Markdown 在别的编辑器里改过，再导入能导回来，只是拷贝过、没改过的不算；导入的提示写清新增、更新和跳过的原因
changes.textEn: Markdown you exported and edited in another editor can be imported back (copies you didn’t change don’t count); the import notice explains what was added, updated and skipped and why

changes.text: 往屏幕边缘的便签里拖图片不再一按就收起；归档后能「取消归档」，快速记一条存好后能直接「打开」
changes.textEn: Dragging an image into a note on the screen edge no longer collapses it the moment you click; archived notes can be unarchived, and a saved Quick Note can be opened right away

changes.text: 很长的便签里打字更跟手
changes.textEn: Typing in very long notes is more responsive

changes.text: 第一次打开时授权屏幕录制后重开 App，引导接着走完，「登录时自动打开」也照样生效
changes.textEn: If you allowed screen recording on first launch and reopened the app, setup now continues to the end, and “Open at login” still takes effect

changes.text: 检查更新只看 Mac 版，下载更新能取消；主界面在小屏幕上不再被程序坞挡住；从访达再打开一次 Kitty Tools 叫出的主界面，粘贴回原来的 App
changes.textEn: Checking for updates looks only at Mac versions, and downloading an update can be canceled; Home is no longer covered by the Dock on small screens; when Home is brought up by opening Kitty Tools again from Finder, it pastes back into the app you were in

changes.text: 截图历史关着时告诉你去哪打开，空着时按你设的天数说保留多久；「存储」一律写明存到哪个文件夹，长图标注的 ▾ 弹出菜单再选
changes.textEn: When Screenshot History is off, it tells you where to turn it on, and when empty it says how long items are kept based on your setting; “Save” always says which folder it saves to, and in long-image annotation the ▾ pop-up menu lets you choose

changes.text: 「同步」那一节的说法不再只提便签，新建同步文件夹时建议的名字改成「Kitty Tools 同步」
changes.textEn: The Sync section no longer talks only about Notes, and the suggested name for a new Sync Folder is now “Kitty Tools 同步”

changes.text: 用快捷键叫出刘海岛后能用键盘：Esc 关、←→ 选、↩ 执行
changes.textEn: After opening the Notch with a shortcut, you can use the keyboard: Esc to close, ←→ to choose, ↩ to run

changes.text: 「去授权」只弹一个窗口；VoiceOver 能打开菜单栏图标的菜单
changes.textEn: “Allow Access” opens only one window; VoiceOver can open the menu bar icon’s menu

changes.text: 改一页几列几行不再打乱分好的页，改完能撤销；用触控板捏合打开时收起主界面
changes.textEn: Changing the number of columns and rows per page no longer scrambles your pages, and you can undo the change; opening Launchpad by pinching on the trackpad closes Home

changes.text: App 很多时打开更快、占内存更少（300 个 App 时第一下快三倍多）
changes.textEn: Opens faster and uses less memory with many apps (over three times faster to open with 300 apps)

changes.text: 系统的捏合手势开着时提示一次，告诉你怎么让四指捏合打开启动台
changes.textEn: When the system pinch gesture is on, a one-time notice tells you how to open Launchpad with a four-finger pinch

changes.text: 斜着移向缩略图时不再换成旁边 App 的窗口；没开屏幕录制时，底下那行能直接点去授权
changes.textEn: Moving diagonally toward a thumbnail no longer switches to the windows of a neighboring app; without screen recording access, you can click the bottom row to allow it

summary: 点菜单栏图标现在打开主界面，全部功能一眼看到、点一下就用（右键还是原来的菜单）。新增程序坞预览（默认关，在 设置 › 程序坞预览 里打开）：鼠标停在程序坞的 App 图标上，弹出它所有窗口的缩略图，点一张就切过去。同步也不再只管便签：设置和快捷键、片段和收藏、生词本、网页搜索、翻译服务、状态屏的状态、启动器收藏都能在几台 Mac 之间同步，每类一个开关。截图多了截图历史（双击一条就能回到那张图上接着改标注，能多选、一起拖出去）和挂截图的晾衣绳，长截图拼完也能标注；刘海岛的提示能停住展开、直接点按钮，点刘海还能把它叫出来。每个功能的图标也重画了一套，小尺寸下更清楚。另外修了一批截图、翻译、启动器、启动台和便签里的老问题。
summaryEn: Clicking the menu bar icon now opens Home, where you can see every feature at a glance and use it with one click (right-click still opens the menu). New Dock Preview (off by default, turn on in Settings › Dock Preview): rest the pointer on an app icon in the Dock to see thumbnails of all its windows, and click one to switch to it. Sync now covers more than Notes: settings and shortcuts, Snippets and Favorites, Word List, Web Search, Translation Services, Status Screen statuses and Launcher favorites can all sync between your Macs, each with its own switch. Screenshot adds Screenshot History (double-click an item to go back to that image and keep annotating; select several and drag them out together) and a Clothesline to hang screenshots on, and scrolling captures can be annotated once stitched. Notices on the Notch stay open when you hover so you can click their buttons, and clicking the notch brings them back. Every feature icon was redrawn to read better at small sizes. Plus a batch of long-standing fixes in Screenshot, Translate, Launcher, Launchpad and Notes.

changes.text: 点菜单栏图标打开主界面：全部功能按菜单的分组排成一格一格，名字下面写着快捷键，点一下就用；暂停记录剪贴板、复制即译是开关，开着时填上强调色。右键（或按住 ⌃ 点）还是原来的菜单。关掉的功能不出现，最下面一行能直接去 设置 › 通用 打开。菜单栏图标藏起来时，再打开一次 Kitty Tools 也是主界面；想用快捷键的到 设置 › 快捷键 给「打开主界面」设一个
changes.textEn: Clicking the menu bar icon opens Home: every feature is laid out in tiles grouped like the menu, with its shortcut under the name, ready to use with one click; Pause Clipboard Recording and Translate on Copy are switches filled with the accent color when on. Right-click (or ⌃-click) still opens the menu. Features you turned off don’t appear, and the bottom row takes you to Settings › General to turn them on. When the menu bar icon is hidden, opening Kitty Tools again also shows Home; to use a shortcut, set one for “Open Home” in Settings › Shortcuts

changes.text: 新增程序坞预览（默认关，在 设置 › 程序坞预览 里打开）：鼠标停在程序坞的 App 图标上，上方弹出这个 App 所有窗口的缩略图，最小化的、隐藏的和别的桌面上的也列出来、标着状态；点一张切到那扇窗口，悬停时点左上角的 ✕ 关掉它。鼠标离开就收起，窗口多了自动换行。要辅助功能授权，有屏幕录制授权才有缩略图（没有就只列窗口的名字）
changes.textEn: New Dock Preview (off by default, turn on in Settings › Dock Preview): rest the pointer on an app icon in the Dock and thumbnails of all that app’s windows pop up above it, including minimized, hidden and other-desktop windows, each labeled with its state. Click one to switch to that window, or click the ✕ in its top-left corner while hovering to close it. It closes when the pointer leaves and wraps to more rows when there are many windows. Requires Accessibility access; thumbnails need Screen Recording access (without it, only window titles are listed)

changes.text: 「同步」不再只管便签：设置 › 通用「同步」里多了几类，各一个开关、默认都开——设置与快捷键、片段和收藏（连同收藏夹和备注）、生词本、网页搜索与快捷链接、翻译服务、状态屏的状态、启动器收藏。同一条两台都改过的，后改的留下；删掉的也会同步，一下删很多时先停下来问。从只同步便签的版本升上来的 Mac，新加的几类先不勾，勾上时先问合不合在一起
changes.textEn: Sync covers more than Notes: Settings › General › Sync adds several kinds, each with its own switch and all on by default—settings and shortcuts, Snippets and Favorites (with collections and notes), Word List, Web Search and Quicklinks, Translation Services, Status Screen statuses, and Launcher favorites. When two Macs both changed the same item, the later change wins; deletions sync too, and Sync pauses to ask when many things are deleted at once. On a Mac updated from a version that only synced Notes, the new kinds start unchecked and ask whether to merge when you check them

changes.text: 设置一项一项比，后改的留下；跟着这台 Mac 的不同步：启动台的排法和行列数、录屏的麦克风和「显示按键」、录音来源、程序坞预览开关、便签放在哪块屏幕、菜单栏图标、面板的图钉。新加入的 Mac 设置换成已经在同步的那几台的，「合在一起？」里写明；正在录屏、录音时先不换
changes.textEn: Settings are compared one by one and the later change wins. Settings tied to a particular Mac don’t sync: the Launchpad layout and grid size, the screen recording microphone and “Show keystrokes”, the audio recording source, the Dock Preview switch, which display Notes sit on, the menu bar icon, and panel pins. A Mac that joins takes the settings of the Macs already syncing, as explained in the “Merge?” prompt; nothing is swapped while you’re recording the screen or audio

changes.text: 翻译服务的密钥不同步：别的 Mac 上那个服务写着「未填密钥」，在那台自己填一次。启动器收藏里这台没装的 App 先不显示，装上就回来
changes.textEn: Translation service keys don’t sync: on another Mac the service shows “No key”, so enter it once on that Mac. Launcher favorites for apps not installed on this Mac stay hidden until the app is installed

changes.text: 刘海岛的提示能操作了：鼠标挪上去就停住，展开成卡片，看得到完整的说明和全部按钮；点 ✕ 或在岛上双指往上滑就收起。缺授权的带「打开系统设置」直达那一项，存好的截图、录屏、导出的文件点岛就在访达里选中，删了能撤的、开关能撤的带「撤销」，转 GIF、压缩、划词翻译并替换带「取消」，翻译、检查更新失败带「重试」，有新版本直接点「更新」
changes.textEn: Notices on the Notch can be used now: they stay open when the pointer moves over them and expand into a card with the full message and all buttons; click ✕ or swipe up with two fingers on the notch to close. Missing permissions come with “Open System Settings” straight to that setting; saved screenshots, recordings and exported files are selected in Finder when you click the notch; deletions and switch changes that can be undone offer “Undo”; converting to GIF, compressing and Translate and Replace Selection offer “Cancel”; failed translations and update checks offer “Retry”; and a new version can be installed right away with “Update”

changes.text: 点刘海就能把岛叫出来：上面一排截图、识字、截图翻译、录屏、录音、快速记一条，下面是最近 10 条提示，错过的能找回来，「在访达中显示」「打开系统设置」这类按钮照样能点。指针停在刘海上时岛会鼓起一点。没有刘海的屏幕用「打开刘海岛」的快捷键（设置 › 快捷键 里自己设）
changes.textEn: Click the notch to bring up the Notch: Take Screenshot, Capture Text, Translate Screenshot, Record Screen, Record Audio and Quick Note across the top, and the 10 most recent notices below, so you can find ones you missed and still click buttons like “Show in Finder” and “Open System Settings”. The notch bulges slightly when the pointer rests on it. On displays without a notch, use the “Open Notch” shortcut (set one in Settings › Shortcuts)

changes.text: 功能图标全部重画：设置、快捷键页、速查表、主界面、菜单栏菜单、刘海岛和启动器里每个功能的图标换成一套新的，小尺寸下也看得清
changes.textEn: All feature icons were redrawn: every feature’s icon in Settings, the Shortcuts page, Keyboard Shortcuts, Home, the menu bar menu, the Notch and Launcher is replaced with a new set that stays legible at small sizes

changes.text: 收藏里还原不出来的 App 不再被顺手删掉，先藏起来、不占 8 个名额
changes.textEn: Launcher favorites for apps that can’t be found are no longer quietly deleted; they’re hidden instead and don’t take up one of the 8 slots

changes.text: 设置 › 通用 最下面多了「数据目录」：点「在访达中显示」打开放剪贴板、便签和翻译历史的数据库、图片和每日备份的文件夹，换电脑手动拷数据、看备份时用
changes.textEn: New “Data Folder” at the bottom of Settings › General: click “Show in Finder” to open the folder with the databases for Clipboard, Notes and translation history, images and daily backups—handy when moving data to a new Mac by hand or checking backups

changes.text: 快捷键速查表改成按功能分类：从设置的哪一页点开就先停在那一类，左边能搜；第一次打开的欢迎引导也列上了全部功能
changes.textEn: Keyboard Shortcuts is now sorted by feature: opened from a Settings page, it starts at that feature, and you can search on the left. First-run setup also lists every feature

changes.text: 翻译浮窗默认出现在屏幕上方正中（和启动器同一个位置），不再跟着鼠标跑；设置 › 翻译「浮窗位置」里还能换回跟随鼠标或上次位置。输入翻译照旧在你上次拖到的地方
changes.textEn: The translation window now appears at the top center of the screen by default (where Launcher opens) instead of following the pointer; you can switch back to near the pointer or the last position in Settings › Translate › Window position. Type to Translate still opens where you last dragged it

changes.text: 导入设置或者别的 Mac 同步来改了源 / 目标语言时，收着的翻译浮窗不再在后台重译；下次打开输入翻译时按新的语言重译
changes.textEn: When importing settings or syncing from another Mac changes the source or target language, a closed translation window no longer retranslates in the background; Type to Translate retranslates in the new language the next time you open it

changes.text: 新增截图历史（菜单栏「截图与录制 › 截图历史…」，也能自己设快捷键）：截图、长截图、钉过的、录屏录音和 GIF 都留在这里，按日期排好、能搜能筛。双击一条就能回到那张图上接着改标注——原图和标注是分开存的，改完更新原来那条；还能再拷贝、存储、按当初的位置钉回屏幕、识字。默认留 30 天、最多占 2 GB，设置 › 截图 里可以调、可以关、可以一键清空；历史只在这台 Mac 上，不跟着同步
changes.textEn: New Screenshot History (menu bar “Screenshot & Recording › Screenshot History…”, or set your own shortcut): screenshots, scrolling captures, pinned screenshots, screen and audio recordings, and GIFs are kept here, sorted by date, searchable and filterable. Double-click an item to go back to that image and keep annotating—the original and the annotations are stored separately, and your edits update the same item. You can also copy, save, pin it back where it was, or capture text. Items are kept for 30 days and up to 2 GB by default; adjust, turn off or clear it in Settings › Screenshot. History stays on this Mac and doesn’t sync

changes.text: 截图历史能多选了：⌘ 点加选、⇧ 点连着选、⌘A 全选，选中的几张一起拷贝、存储、删除，或者直接拖进访达、聊天窗口、邮件——拖着的时候指针下是选中的那几张摞成一叠，画过标注的拖出去是改好的成品。窗口里也有一套快捷键：⌘C 拷贝、⌘S 存储、⌘P 钉图、⌘O 识字并拷贝、↩ 改标注、⌘F 跳到搜索框，方向键在图之间挑
changes.textEn: Screenshot History supports multiple selection: ⌘-click to add, ⇧-click to select a range, ⌘A to select all, then copy, save or delete them together, or drag them straight into Finder, a chat window or an email—while dragging, the selected images are stacked under the pointer, and annotated ones go out as the finished result. The window has its own shortcuts: ⌘C copy, ⌘S save, ⌘P pin, ⌘O capture text and copy, ↩ annotate, ⌘F jump to search, and arrow keys to move between images

changes.text: 长截图拼完能标注了：面板上多一颗「标注」（按 A），整屏压暗、长图摆在中间、工具栏贴在图下方（和截图标注一个样子），十种标注工具、样式和手感都和截图里的一样——画完拖手柄改大小、⌥ 拖复制、⌘Z 撤销，缩小看长图时手柄照样点得中；标完 ↩ 拷贝、⌘S 存储、⇧⌘S 另存为、O 识字。面板的另存为收进了存储右边的 ▾
changes.textEn: Scrolling captures can be annotated once stitched: the panel has a new “Annotate” button (press A) that dims the screen, centers the long image and puts the toolbar below it (just like screenshot annotation). All ten annotation tools, styles and behavior match screenshots—drag handles to resize, ⌥-drag to duplicate, ⌘Z to undo, and handles stay easy to hit when zoomed out on a long image. When done, ↩ copies, ⌘S saves, ⇧⌘S saves as, and O captures text. The panel’s Save As moved into the ▾ next to Save

changes.text: 改标注时（截图历史里双击一张、长截图拼完按 A），图外面也有截图框选时那道边框，图的四个角不再被圆角裁掉
changes.textEn: When annotating (double-clicking an item in Screenshot History, or pressing A after a scrolling capture), the image gets the same border as when selecting a screenshot, and its corners are no longer cut off by rounding

changes.text: 长截图的预览能往回看了：鼠标移到右边面板的预览上滚动，就能看前面已经拼好的部分，预览右边一条细线说明在整张图的哪一段；双击预览或滚回最新那头回到跟随。往回看的时候下面的页面不跟着滚
changes.textEn: You can look back in the scrolling capture preview: scroll over the preview in the panel on the right to see the parts already stitched, with a thin line beside it showing where you are in the whole image; double-click the preview or scroll back to the newest end to follow again. The page underneath doesn’t scroll while you look back

changes.text: 新增晾衣绳：截完图挂到屏幕顶上一根绳子上，手边常备一排（设置 › 截图「截完图放哪」里选，和右下角的缩略图二选一）。鼠标停到菜单栏那一条上绳子就滑下来，移开收起；单击拷贝、双击改标注、拖出去发一份、点右上角的叉取下，右键还有存储、钉图、从历史里删掉。最多挂 8 张，取下只是从绳子上拿走、历史里还在；也能自己设一个快捷键叫它出来
changes.textEn: New Clothesline: screenshots hang on a line along the top of the screen so a row of them is always at hand (choose it in Settings › Screenshot › “After capture”, instead of the thumbnail in the bottom-right corner). Rest the pointer on the strip in the menu bar and the line slides down; move away and it goes back up. Click to copy, double-click to annotate, drag one out to send a copy, or click the ✕ in the top-right corner to take it down; right-click for Save, Pin and Delete from History. Up to 8 hang at once, and taking one down only removes it from the line—it stays in history. You can also set a shortcut to bring it up

changes.text: 截图时在文字标注或尺寸框里打字，⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z 撤销、重做的是刚打的字了（原来按了没反应）
changes.textEn: When typing in a text annotation or the size field while taking a screenshot, ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z now undo and redo what you just typed (they used to do nothing)

changes.text: 长截图对着电脑上开的移动端网页（两边是灰色留白）、或者框进了不跟着滚的侧栏和开发者工具时，也能一直接上，不再一直显示「对不上」
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture keeps stitching on mobile web pages opened on a computer (with gray margins on both sides), or when the selection includes sidebars or developer tools that don’t scroll, instead of constantly saying it lost track

changes.text: 新装或系统更新之后第一次识字、截图翻译要等一分钟左右（系统要先准备识字模型）：现在启动后在后台提前准备好；没准备完就去识字的话，刘海岛上写清楚在等什么、已经等了几秒
changes.textEn: After a fresh install or a system update, the first Capture Text or Translate Screenshot used to take about a minute (the system has to prepare its text recognition model): it’s now prepared in the background after launch, and if you start before it’s ready, the Notch says what it’s waiting for and for how long

changes.text: 截图翻译和识字框选时，放大镜下面不再挂着取色那张卡（那时本来也按不了 C 复制色值）
changes.textEn: When selecting for Translate Screenshot or Capture Text, the color card no longer hangs under the magnifier (you couldn’t press C to copy the color then anyway)

changes.text: 截图框选时快速划动鼠标，放大镜和取色紧跟着光标，不再落在后面
changes.textEn: When you move the mouse quickly while selecting a screenshot, the magnifier and color picker keep up with the pointer instead of lagging behind

changes.text: 翻译正在出字时按 Esc 收起浮窗，那张卡不再一直停在「生成中」转个不停，再打开输入翻译会从头重跑；出字中途重新翻译，新卡也不会先闪一下旧译文
changes.textEn: Pressing Esc to close the translation window while a translation is still coming in no longer leaves that card spinning on “Generating” forever, and opening Type to Translate again reruns it from the start; retranslating mid-way no longer flashes the old translation in the new card first

changes.text: 排在最前的翻译服务没翻成（比如没填密钥）时，收藏、替换原文、记历史、自动复制改用下一个翻成功的服务，不再全都用不了；自动复制只复制这一个，不会每个服务各复制一次
changes.textEn: When the first translation service fails (for example, it has no key), Favorites, replacing the original, history and auto-copy use the next service that succeeded instead of all failing; auto-copy copies only that one, not once per service

changes.text: 断网或网络出错时，微软翻译和翻译服务里的「获取模型」也说清楚是怎么了（比如「网络不可用」），不再冒出系统的英文报错或笼统的「服务出错」
changes.textEn: When the network is down or fails, Microsoft Translator and “Get Models” in Translation Services now say what happened (such as “The network is unavailable”) instead of showing a raw system error or a vague “The service had an error”

changes.text: 开着复制即译时，复制中文也会弹出翻译（翻成第二语言），原来只有复制外文才弹；网址、路径、纯数字照旧不翻
changes.textEn: With Translate on Copy on, copying Chinese also brings up a translation (into your second language); it used to appear only for foreign text. URLs, paths and plain numbers still aren’t translated

changes.text: 大模型翻出来的标题、列表、引用和代码块按排版显示，不再露出 #、-、> 这些记号；复制出来的还是原样的文字
changes.textEn: Headings, lists, quotes and code blocks in translations from AI models are shown formatted instead of exposing #, - and > marks; what you copy is still the plain text

changes.text: 启动器里输入 ip，最前面列出本机的局域网地址（Wi-Fi、以太网各一行，连着 VPN 的还有内网地址）和外网地址，↩ 粘贴、⌘↩ 只复制。外网地址要联网查：开着代理时访问国内、国外网站用的地址常常不一样，这时两个都列出来、写清是哪边的
changes.textEn: Type ip in Launcher to see this Mac’s local network addresses first (one row each for Wi-Fi and Ethernet, plus the internal address when on a VPN) and its public address; ↩ pastes, ⌘↩ only copies. The public address is looked up online: with a proxy on, the address used for sites at home and abroad often differs, so both are listed and labeled

changes.text: 中文名直接写在 App 里的（企业微信、微信开发者工具这类），在启动器和启动台里用拼音、首字母也搜得到了
changes.textEn: Apps whose Chinese name is built into the app itself can be found in Launcher and Launchpad by pinyin and initials too

changes.text: 启动器搜得更顺：文件搜索结果多时打字不再一顿一顿，浏览器书签几千个时也跟手；刚装完 App 马上呼出启动器，面板当场出来、先用上一次的列表，新 App 一眨眼就补上
changes.textEn: Launcher search is smoother: typing no longer stutters when there are many file results, and it keeps up with thousands of browser bookmarks. Right after installing an app, Launcher opens immediately with the previous list and adds the new app a moment later

changes.text: 有卡住的网络盘时，port、kill 不再一直停在「正在读取端口…」，2 秒左右就列出来
changes.textEn: With a stuck network drive, port and kill no longer hang on “Reading ports…” and list results in about 2 seconds

changes.text: App 升级换了图标之后，启动台和启动器里显示的也换成新图标，不再一直是旧的
changes.textEn: When an app update changes its icon, Launchpad and Launcher show the new icon instead of the old one

changes.text: 装进「应用程序」里某个子文件夹的新 App，过一会儿再打开启动台就会出现（打开时隔一阵在后台重新看一遍，不挡打开）
changes.textEn: New apps installed in a subfolder of Applications appear in Launchpad a little later (it rechecks in the background from time to time when opened, without slowing down opening)

changes.text: 第一次打开启动台、岛上还写着「正在按原来的启动台排列…」时就拖起了图标，松手后换上的排法现在会存下来，下次打开还是它
changes.textEn: If you started dragging icons the first time you opened Launchpad, while the notch still said “Arranging like the original Launchpad…”, the layout after you let go is now saved and is still there next time

changes.text: 删掉一条便签之后，刘海岛上那句「已删除」多了一颗「放回」：点一下就回到原来的位置，颜色、固定、归档都照旧；几秒之内连着删了几条，岛上写删了几条，「放回」一起放回。屏幕边缘那叠、浮动便签、全部便签窗口都一样
changes.textEn: After you delete a note, the “Deleted” notice on the Notch has a “Put Back” button that returns it to where it was, with its color, pinning and archive state intact. If you delete several within a few seconds, the notice says how many and “Put Back” restores them all. Works the same for the stack on the screen edge, Floating Notes and the All Notes window

changes.text: 在全部便签窗口里搜索时，选中或打开一条结果，正文会自己滚到第一处搜到的地方、闪一下标出来；词被颜色隔开或者中间夹着图片也找得到。焦点还留在列表上，方向键照常换条
changes.textEn: When you search in the All Notes window and select or open a result, the note scrolls to the first match and briefly highlights it; words split by colors or with an image in the middle are found too. Focus stays on the list, so arrow keys still move between notes

changes.text: 便签有几千条时不再卡：全部便签窗口的搜索框里打字跟手（第一个字之后每个字都马上出结果），搜着的时候改正文不粘键盘；屏幕边缘那叠点开「+N」一下就展开，滚动跟手
changes.textEn: No more lag with thousands of notes: typing in the All Notes search field keeps up (results appear right after every character after the first), and editing a note while searching doesn’t stick. Clicking “+N” in the stack on the screen edge expands it at once, and scrolling keeps up

changes.text: 开着便签同步时，另一台 Mac 往便签里贴的图，这台的便签墙上要重启才出缩略图、正开着的这条便签里一直是占位框；现在图一同步过来就换上
