changes.textEn: With Notes sync on, images another Mac pasted into a note used to need a restart to show thumbnails on the Note Wall, and stayed as placeholders in an open note; they now appear as soon as the image syncs

changes.text: 屏幕边缘那叠和浮动便签在窗口变大小时（展开那一列、换一条、拉大小）可能让 Kitty 闪退，修好了
changes.textEn: Fixed a possible crash in the stack on the screen edge and Floating Notes when their windows changed size (expanding the column, switching notes, resizing)

changes.text: 开着同步时，几台 Mac 上都没改东西的那几轮几乎不花时间，便签上千条时也不会每 20 秒卡一下
changes.textEn: With sync on, rounds where nothing changed on any Mac take almost no time, so even with thousands of notes there’s no hitch every 20 seconds

changes.text: 应用内更新装好后，要是退出被取消了（比如便签没存上时点了「取消」），不再一直显示「正在安装」：刘海岛和关于页写「已装好，退出后重新打开即生效」，关于页还能点「现在重新打开」
changes.textEn: If quitting was canceled after an in-app update was installed (for example, you clicked “Cancel” when a note wasn’t saved), it no longer keeps saying “Installing”: the Notch and About page say it’s installed and takes effect after you quit and reopen, and the About page offers “Reopen Now”

summary: 新增启动台（macOS 26 起；macOS 15 上不出现，用系统自带的）：按一个键（或者捏合触控板）就出全屏的图标网格，像原来那样一页一页翻、直接搜 App 打开。和现有的「启动器」是两个东西：启动器是搜索框，启动台是看图标的地方。便签也多了几样：能在几台 Mac 之间同步，图片右键能一下选好宽度、能裁切，纸色能自己挑，能同时浮几张。另外，用不着的功能可以在 设置 › 通用 里整个关掉。
summaryEn: New Launchpad (macOS 26 and later; it doesn’t appear on macOS 15, which has the system’s own): press a key (or pinch on the trackpad) for a full-screen icon grid, page through it as before, and search for apps to open them. It’s separate from Launcher: Launcher is a search field, Launchpad is where you browse icons. Notes gains a few things too: sync between your Macs, picking an image width from the right-click menu, cropping, custom paper colors, and several Floating Notes at once. And features you don’t need can be turned off entirely in Settings › General.

changes.text: 新增启动台：全屏的图标网格，背景是自己的桌面壁纸糊开的样子，App 按页排开，图标下面写着名字。底部一排圆点看在第几页，点圆点跳页；触控板两指左右滑翻页，鼠标滚轮上下滚也翻页；方向键在图标之间挪选中，到页边接着翻页，回车打开选中的
changes.textEn: New Launchpad: a full-screen icon grid over a blurred version of your desktop picture, with apps laid out in pages and their names under the icons. A row of dots at the bottom shows which page you’re on—click a dot to jump; swipe left or right with two fingers on the trackpad or scroll the mouse wheel to turn pages; arrow keys move the selection between icons and turn the page at the edge, and Return opens the selected app

changes.text: 启动台顶上有一个搜索框，打开就能直接打字：中文名、拼音、首字母、英文名都搜得到，文件夹里的 App 也算；只显示匹配的，回车打开第一个，按 Esc 先清掉搜索、再按一次收起
changes.textEn: Launchpad has a search field at the top that you can type into right away: Chinese names, pinyin, initials and English names all work, including apps inside folders. Only matches are shown, Return opens the first one, and Esc clears the search first, then closes on a second press

changes.text: 打开启动台：菜单栏里多了一项「启动台」，现有启动器里输入「启动台」也能打开；全局快捷键默认没有，到 设置 › 快捷键 里自己录一个。打开一个 App 时启动台自己收起，那个 App 接着到前面来；在调度中心里打开时，调度中心先退掉
changes.textEn: Opening Launchpad: the menu bar has a new “Launchpad” item, and typing “Launchpad” in Launcher opens it too. There’s no global shortcut by default; record one in Settings › Shortcuts. Launchpad closes itself when you open an app and that app comes to the front; opened from Mission Control, Mission Control exits first

changes.text: 图标能拖：按住稍拖就拿起，别的图标让位；拖到屏幕左右边缘停一下翻页；拖到另一个图标的中心停一下才合成文件夹（只从旁边拖过是排序），拖到文件夹上就加进去，拖出文件夹回到主网格。每次挪完马上记下，一页放不下时挤出来的那个顺到下一页开头
changes.textEn: Icons can be dragged: press and drag slightly to pick one up, and the others make room. Pause at the left or right edge of the screen to turn the page; pause over the center of another icon to make a folder (just passing by reorders); drop onto a folder to add to it, and drag out of a folder to return to the main grid. Every move is saved right away, and when a page overflows, the icon pushed out moves to the start of the next page

changes.text: 文件夹：点开在屏幕中间展开，后面的图标糊掉不添乱，名字在上方、点一下就能改；里面多于一页能翻页；只剩一个 App 时自动解散，空了就消失
changes.textEn: Folders: click one to open it in the middle of the screen with the icons behind it blurred out of the way; the name is at the top, and clicking it lets you rename. Folders with more than a page can be paged through; a folder with only one app left dissolves, and an empty one disappears

changes.text: 按住图标约 1 秒、或按住 ⌥ 进入抖动模式：图标轻轻晃，从 App Store 装的左上角出现 ✕，点了确认后移到废纸篓；点空白、按 Esc、松开 ⌥ 退出
changes.textEn: Press and hold an icon for about 1 second, or hold ⌥, to enter jiggle mode: icons wiggle gently, apps from the App Store show a ✕ in the top-left corner, and clicking it and confirming moves the app to the Trash. Click empty space, press Esc or release ⌥ to exit

changes.text: 触控板捏合打开：把 系统设置 › 触控板 › 更多手势 里的「应用程序」那一行关掉之后，在任何 App 里四指（拇指和三指）或五指捏合就打开启动台，画面跟着手指走：捏到一半松手会退回去，快快一捏就打开；开着时张开手指同样跟着手收起。用四指还是五指在设置里选；多个触控板都认，灵敏度三档。系统的还开着时设置页会提示，那一行可以直达触控板设置
changes.textEn: Open with a trackpad pinch: after turning off the “Launchpad” row in System Settings › Trackpad › More Gestures, pinch with four fingers (thumb and three fingers) or five in any app to open Launchpad, and it follows your fingers: let go halfway and it goes back, pinch quickly and it opens; spreading your fingers closes it the same way. Choose four or five fingers in Settings; multiple trackpads are supported, with three sensitivity levels. If the system gesture is still on, the settings page says so, and that row links straight to Trackpad settings

changes.text: 触发角：设置里选一个屏幕角，鼠标推到那里停一下打开启动台（默认关）
changes.textEn: Hot corner: choose a screen corner in Settings, and moving the pointer there and pausing opens Launchpad (off by default)

changes.text: 第一次打开会按系统里原来的启动台排好：页、文件夹、顺序都照旧，已经卸掉的 App 跳过；设置里随时可以重新导入，导入前留一份、能撤销一次
changes.textEn: The first time it opens, Launchpad arranges itself like the system’s original Launchpad: pages, folders and order stay as they were, skipping apps you’ve uninstalled. You can reimport anytime in Settings; a copy is kept before importing, so you can undo once

changes.text: 设置里多了「启动台」一页：启用开关、一页几列几行、触控板捏合、触发角、从系统启动台导入、恢复默认排列，以及把现在的排法换回去一次的撤销
changes.textEn: New Launchpad page in Settings: the on/off switch, columns and rows per page, trackpad pinch, hot corner, importing from the system Launchpad, restoring the default layout, and a one-time undo to switch the current layout back

changes.text: 用不着的功能可以整个关掉：设置 › 通用 最上面多了「功能」一组，剪贴板、启动器、翻译、截图、录制、便签、启动台、状态屏各一个开关，每个功能自己那一页的第一行也能开关。关掉的功能不出现在快捷键、菜单栏和启动器里，快捷键让给别的 App 用，也不在后台运行；它的数据和设置都留着，打开就回来，不用重启
changes.textEn: Features you don’t need can be turned off entirely: a new “Features” group at the top of Settings › General has a switch each for Clipboard, Launcher, Translate, Screenshot, Recording, Notes, Launchpad and Status Screen, and the first row of each feature’s page can turn it on or off too. A feature that’s off disappears from shortcuts, the menu bar and Launcher, hands its shortcuts to other apps and doesn’t run in the background; its data and settings are kept and come back when you turn it on, with no restart

changes.text: 便签里的图片右键有了自己的菜单：宽度分小、中、大、铺满、原始大小五档，现在是哪档打着勾；选中几张图一起改，⌘Z 一步退回；菜单里也能直接拷贝这张图
changes.textEn: Images in notes have their own right-click menu: five widths—small, medium, large, full width and original size—with a checkmark on the current one; select several images to change them together, and ⌘Z undoes it in one step. You can also copy the image from this menu

changes.text: 便签的纸色能自己挑：颜色菜单最后多了「其他颜色…」，用系统的取色面板挑任意一个颜色，边拖边变；挑过的记在颜色菜单里「最近用过」那一节（最多 8 个），一点就换。挑的浅色就是纸本身，太深的会自动调浅到字看得清，深色外观、增强对比度跟着变。把便签导出给更早的版本时，显示成 8 种里最接近的那种，回到新版本颜色还在
changes.textEn: Choose your own paper color for notes: the color menu ends with “Other Color…”, which opens the system color picker so you can pick any color and see it change as you drag. Colors you picked are kept in a “Recently Used” section of the color menu (up to 8) for one-click switching. A light color becomes the paper itself, and dark ones are lightened automatically so text stays readable, adapting to Dark Mode and Increase Contrast. Notes exported to older versions show the closest of the 8 standard colors, and the color is still there when they come back to the new version

changes.text: 浮在屏幕上的便签能同时有几张（最多 5 张）：从屏幕边缘拖出来、菜单里「浮在屏幕上」都是再加一张（从菜单浮出来的和已经浮着的错开摆，不叠在一起），各挪各的、各收各的；再多一张时最久没碰的那张自己收回边缘。屏幕边缘那叠里浮着的几条都带记号，点哪条就把那张叫到前面。收回一张之后键盘回到你原来用的 App，不会跳进另一张便签；固定着的每一张重启后都回到原处
changes.textEn: You can have several Floating Notes at once (up to 5): dragging one out from the screen edge or choosing “Float on Screen” from the menu adds another (ones floated from the menu are offset from those already floating instead of stacking), and each moves and goes back on its own; adding one more sends the one you haven’t touched for longest back to the edge. Floating notes are marked in the stack on the screen edge, and clicking one brings it to the front. After one goes back, the keyboard returns to the app you were using instead of jumping into another note; every pinned one returns to where it was after a restart

changes.text: 便签里的图片能裁切：右键图片选「裁切…」，在便签上直接拖框（拖角、拖边、按住框里挪），比例能选自由、原比例、1:1、4:3、16:9 和竖着的几种，↩ 完成、Esc 取消。裁好的另存一张、原图不动，⌘Z 一步回到原图；之前选好的宽度按比例跟着变，屏上的大小不跳
changes.textEn: Images in notes can be cropped: right-click an image and choose “Crop…”, then drag the frame right on the note (drag corners and edges, or drag inside to move it). Aspect ratios include freeform, original, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 and portrait versions; ↩ finishes and Esc cancels. The crop is saved as a new image and the original is untouched, so ⌘Z returns to the original in one step; a width you chose earlier scales along, so the size on screen doesn’t jump

changes.text: 便签能在几台 Mac 之间同步（默认关）：设置 › 通用「同步」里选一个几台 Mac 都看得到的空文件夹（比如在 iCloud 云盘里新建一个），每台选同一个就合在一起。改的字、颜色、固定、归档、删除、排序和正文里的图片都会过去，一般几十秒到几分钟；两台改了同一条时后改的留下，另一版放进「最近删除」；一下要放进「最近删除」的太多会先停下来问；正在打字的那条等你停下来再合。设置里看得到上次同步的时刻和另外几台 Mac，出了问题写着为什么。文件夹里放的是不加密的文件
changes.textEn: Notes can sync between your Macs (off by default): in Settings › General › Sync, choose an empty folder all your Macs can see (for example, a new one in iCloud Drive), and choose the same folder on each to merge them. Text, colors, pinning, archiving, deletions, order and images in notes all carry over, usually within tens of seconds to a few minutes. When two Macs edit the same note, the later edit wins and the other version goes to Recently Deleted; if too many would go to Recently Deleted at once, Sync pauses to ask; the note you’re typing in merges after you stop. Settings shows the last sync time and your other Macs, and explains what went wrong if something does. The files in the folder aren’t encrypted

changes.text: 截图翻译能把识别出的原文直接放进剪贴板：设置 › 翻译 打开「截图翻译时复制识别出的原文」，识别完就能 ⌘V 粘贴（默认关，照旧只记进剪贴板历史）
changes.textEn: Translate Screenshot can put the recognized source text straight on the clipboard: turn on “Copy recognized text when translating screenshots” in Settings › Translate, and press ⌘V once it’s recognized (off by default, so it’s only recorded in Clipboard History as before)

changes.text: 在浮动便签或屏幕边缘打开的便签里叫出剪贴板面板、启动器或快速记一条，没粘贴就按 Esc（或 ⌘W、再按一次快捷键）关掉之后，键盘回到这条便签，不用再点一下就能接着打字
changes.textEn: If you bring up the Clipboard panel, Launcher or Quick Note from a Floating Note or a note opened on the screen edge, then close it without pasting (Esc, ⌘W or the shortcut again), the keyboard returns to the note so you can keep typing without clicking

changes.text: 屏幕边缘打开着一条没固定的便签时，打开系统的「表情与符号」挑表情、用鼠标点输入法的候选词，便签不再收起来；剪贴板面板、启动器、快速记一条也一样
changes.textEn: With an unpinned note open on the screen edge, opening the system’s Emoji & Symbols to pick an emoji or clicking an input method candidate with the mouse no longer closes the note; the same goes for the Clipboard panel, Launcher and Quick Note

changes.text: 放在代码块里的图片，导出成 Markdown 时也一起带上图片文件，导回来还是原来那张图
changes.textEn: Images inside code blocks are exported along with their files when exporting to Markdown, and come back as the same image when imported

changes.text: 从网页、文档里粘贴进来带软换行的文字，那几行排得和别的行一样齐：引用的缩进、标题的大小都对了，撤销照常
changes.textEn: Text pasted from web pages and documents with soft line breaks now lines up like other lines: quote indents and heading sizes are right, and undo works as usual

changes.text: 特别长的便签里挪光标、打字更跟手：挪一下光标要做的事少了一半多，每一行都上了文字颜色的也一样
changes.textEn: Moving the cursor and typing in very long notes is more responsive: moving the cursor does less than half the work it used to, even when every line has text colors

summary: 新增便签：留着看、接着改的东西有了自己的地方。在任何 App 里按 ⌥N 随手记一条，鼠标靠到屏幕边缘就能翻开一条接着写；在「全部便签」里看、改、搜索、归档，还能贴图片、写任务、上颜色、整个导出成 Markdown。便签单独保存、每天自动备份，删掉的 30 天内能找回。
summaryEn: New Notes: things you want to keep and come back to now have a place of their own. Press ⌥N in any app to jot down a note, and move the pointer to the screen edge to open one and keep writing. View, edit, search and archive in “All Notes”, with images, tasks, colors, and export of everything to Markdown. Notes are stored separately, backed up automatically every day, and deleted notes can be recovered for 30 days.

changes.text: 快速记一条：在任何 App 里按 ⌥N，屏幕上部出一块小面板，写完按 ↩ 就记下，不用切换窗口；⇧↩ 换行。⌘1 记成新便签，⌘2–9 接在最近改过的某一条便签后面。记成新便签时顶上可以填一个标题（按 Tab 过去，填完按 Tab 或 ↩ 回来；不填就用第一行）；只是点开又点到别处，下次呼出还在，按 Esc 才清空
changes.textEn: Quick Note: press ⌥N in any app and a small panel appears near the top of the screen; type and press ↩ to save it without switching windows, and ⇧↩ for a new line. ⌘1 saves it as a new note, and ⌘2–9 appends it to one of your recently edited notes. When saving as a new note you can fill in a title at the top (press Tab to get there, then Tab or ↩ to come back; without one, the first line is used). If you just open it and click elsewhere, it’s still there next time; only Esc clears it

changes.text: 全部便签窗口（菜单栏或启动器里的「全部便签」）：默认是一面便签墙，每条便签是一张纸色卡片，写着标题、开头几行、做完几条任务和时间，按窗口宽度排成几列、微微斜着叠下去，固定的排在最前；点一张在窗口中央放大、直接接着写，Esc、⌘W 或点旁边收回，方向键挑、↩ 或空格打开，「全部」里按住一张能拖顺序。原来的两栏列表还在（⌘1 / ⌘2 切换），8 种纸色、搜索、归档、固定都行；删掉的先进「最近删除」留 30 天，⌘Z 放回。便签单独存一份库、每天自动备份留最近 7 份，和剪贴板历史互不影响，「设置 › 通用」的导出导入和每日备份里也有便签一类
changes.textEn: The All Notes window (“All Notes” in the menu bar or Launcher): by default it’s a Note Wall where each note is a paper-colored card with its title, first few lines, tasks done and time, laid out in columns to fit the window and stacked at a slight tilt, with pinned notes first. Click a card to enlarge it in the middle of the window and keep writing; Esc, ⌘W or clicking beside it puts it back. Arrow keys choose, ↩ or Space opens, and in “All” you can drag a card to reorder. The original two-column list is still there (⌘1 / ⌘2 to switch), with 8 paper colors, search, archiving and pinning. Deleted notes go to Recently Deleted for 30 days, and ⌘Z puts them back. Notes have their own database with daily backups (the last 7 kept), separate from Clipboard History, and export, import and daily backups in Settings › General include Notes too

changes.text: 屏幕边缘的便签：有了第一条便签，屏幕右边缘出现一条小药丸，一条便签一道色条；第一次用会先放一条讲怎么用的示例便签。鼠标靠过去展开成一列微微斜着叠在边上的标签，点一张便签从边缘滑出来、直接打字，点别处收回，⌘P 固定后不收；停一下能先看开头几行，按着标签上下拖能调顺序，最下面的「+」新建一条，右键标签能固定、换颜色、浮到屏幕上、归档、删除。「设置 › 便签」里能改边、显示器、样式、大小、感应范围、打开的便签多大、一直展开、不要药丸、悬停预览、悬停即打开、盖在全屏 App 上，也能整个关掉；按住 ⌥ 拖药丸能换边、换高度。别的 App 全屏时默认不显示，截图和录屏里不会有这条药丸
changes.textEn: Notes on the screen edge: once you have a note, a small pill appears on the right edge of the screen with a colored stripe per note; the first time, a sample note explains how it works. Move the pointer there and it expands into a column of slightly tilted tabs along the edge; click one and the note slides out ready for typing, and clicking elsewhere puts it back unless you pin it with ⌘P. Pause to preview the first few lines, drag tabs up or down to reorder, use the “+” at the bottom for a new note, and right-click a tab to pin it, change its color, float it on screen, archive or delete it. In Settings › Notes you can change the edge, display, style, size, sensitive area, size of the open note, keep it expanded, hide the pill, preview on hover, open on hover, show it over full-screen apps, or turn it off entirely; ⌥-drag the pill to change its edge and height. It’s hidden by default while another app is full screen, and never appears in screenshots or screen recordings

changes.text: 浮动便签：在屏幕边缘打开一条便签，按住它侧边写着标题的标签往外拖，它就脱出来留在你放的地方，松手接着打字；按着标签能挪，四边四角能拉大小（拉过的记住），一次一张，再浮一张时前一张收回边缘。它一直在别的窗口上面，切到别的 App 也不会被盖住；点头部的图钉固定之后，重启后还在原来的位置。按 Esc 或点 ✕ 收回边缘（屏幕边缘关着时是取消浮动）；不想拖也行，⌘K 的操作菜单和「全部便签」的工具栏、右键菜单里都有「浮在屏幕上」。截图和录屏里有它
changes.textEn: Floating Notes: open a note on the screen edge, drag the tab with its title on the side outward, and it detaches and stays where you drop it, ready for typing. Drag the tab to move it and its edges and corners to resize (the size is remembered); one at a time, so floating another sends the previous one back to the edge. It stays above other windows even when you switch apps; pin it with the pin in its header and it returns to the same place after a restart. Press Esc or click ✕ to send it back to the edge (or stop floating when the screen edge is off). If you’d rather not drag, “Float on Screen” is in the ⌘K actions menu and in the toolbar and right-click menu of “All Notes”. It does appear in screenshots and screen recordings

changes.text: 便签里的任务有五种状态：待办、进行中、紧急、完成、取消（方框是一套圆角方框：紧急是红底感叹号，完成是打了勾的实心方框，完成和取消的字划线变淡）。点方框：待办、进行中、紧急变成完成，完成、取消变回待办，右键点方框或者选「任务状态」能把选中的几行改成任意一种；按 ⌘T 把光标所在的行变成任务，选中几行就一起变，再按一次变回普通行。任务行、列表行里回车接着出下一条，空的那条上回车退出；Tab / ⇧Tab 缩进、退回；行首按 Markdown 的方框写法再按空格，直接变成任务方框（进行中、紧急、完成、取消的写法也认）。进度只算完成的和没取消的，列表和预览卡上写着做完几条、共几条
changes.textEn: Tasks in notes have five states: to do, in progress, urgent, done and canceled (drawn as a set of rounded boxes: urgent is an exclamation mark on red, done is a filled box with a checkmark, and done and canceled tasks are struck through and faded). Clicking the box turns to do, in progress and urgent into done, and done and canceled back into to do; right-click the box or choose “Task Status” to set the selected lines to any state. ⌘T turns the current line into a task, or all selected lines, and pressing it again turns them back. Return in a task or list line starts the next one, and Return on an empty one ends the list; Tab / ⇧Tab indent and outdent; typing the Markdown checkbox syntax at the start of a line followed by Space turns it into a task box (the syntax for in progress, urgent, done and canceled works too). Progress counts only done tasks out of those not canceled, shown on the list and preview cards

changes.text: 正文里能写 Markdown：行首井号加空格是标题（一到六级），两个星号夹粗体、一个星号夹斜体、两个波浪号夹删除线、反引号夹代码，行首大于号加空格是引用，方括号里写字、后面紧跟圆括号写网址是链接（按住 ⌘ 点打开），列表符号只变淡。标记平时藏起来、只在光标所在的行露出来，存下来的还是原文，便签标题和摘要不带标记；设置 › 便签能关。正文排得更松，标题、引用、代码块前后留白，行距有紧凑、标准、宽松三档；一行开头打三个反引号、几行后再打三个反引号收尾就是代码块（三个波浪号也行，只打开头时后面的不变样）。⌘F 在便签里出查找条，边打边高亮、↩ 跳下一处、Esc 先关查找条；⌘Z 撤销、⇧⌘Z 重做打的字，勾任务、回车接出来的也能撤
changes.textEn: Write Markdown in notes: a hash and a space at the start of a line make a heading (levels one to six); double asterisks for bold, single for italic, double tildes for strikethrough, backticks for code; a greater-than sign and a space at the start of a line for a quote; text in square brackets followed right away by a URL in parentheses for a link (⌘-click to open); list markers are just faded. Marks stay hidden except on the line with the cursor, the original text is what’s saved, and note titles and previews show no marks; you can turn it off in Settings › Notes. Text is laid out more loosely, with space around headings, quotes and code blocks, and three line spacing options: compact, standard and relaxed. Three backticks at the start of a line, closed by three more a few lines later, make a code block (three tildes work too; with only an opening fence, the rest doesn’t change). ⌘F shows a find bar in the note that highlights as you type, ↩ jumps to the next match and Esc closes the find bar first; ⌘Z undoes and ⇧⌘Z redoes typing, including checking off tasks and lines continued with Return

changes.text: 选中字按 ⌘B 加粗、⌘I 斜体、⇧⌘X 删除线、⌘E 变成代码，再按一次去掉；右键「格式」里还有标题 1–3、引用、无序列表、有序列表、代码块、链接、清除格式，选区在代码块里时只有代码块能用。选中的字能上红、橙、绿、蓝、紫、灰六种颜色（深色外观下也看得清），右键「文字颜色」或按 ⌃↩ 选，选「默认颜色」去掉，⌘Z 能撤回；三处便签都能用。选中一段字再粘贴一个网址，这段字就变成指向它的链接。一段字里已经加过同一种格式的，全选再加一次会合成一段，不再拆成好几段
changes.textEn: Select text and press ⌘B for bold, ⌘I for italic, ⇧⌘X for strikethrough or ⌘E for code, and press again to remove it; the right-click “Format” menu also has Heading 1–3, quote, bulleted list, numbered list, code block, link and Clear Formatting, with only code block available inside a code block. Selected text can be colored red, orange, green, blue, purple or gray (readable in Dark Mode too) from the right-click “Text Color” menu or with ⌃↩; “Default Color” removes it, and ⌘Z undoes it. Works in all three kinds of notes. Select some text and paste a URL to turn it into a link to that URL. Text that already has the same format in parts merges into one when you select all and apply it again, instead of splitting into pieces

changes.text: 正文里能放图片：截完图按 ⌘V 贴进去，也能把图片文件从访达拖进来，或者右键选「插入图片…」；每张图独占一行，插完光标落到图下面那一行，插错了按 ⌘Z 一次撤掉。单击图片选中它，拖右下角把手改宽度（比例不变，最小 40 pt、最宽到正文那么宽），拖到一半按 Esc 回原大小；删除、撤销和别的字一样。图片单独存在便签的数据目录里，每天跟着备份，删掉便签后的 30 天里也找得回来；文件不在了画一个占位框，放回来又看得到。标题、列表、便签墙上用「图片」两个字带过；墙上带图的卡片顶上显示第一张图的缩略图
changes.textEn: Notes can hold images: paste a screenshot with ⌘V, drag an image file in from Finder, or right-click and choose “Insert Image…”. Each image gets its own line, the cursor lands on the line below, and ⌘Z removes a mistaken insert in one go. Click an image to select it and drag the bottom-right handle to change its width (keeping proportions, from 40 pt up to the width of the text), pressing Esc mid-drag to go back to the original size; deleting and undoing work like text. Images are stored separately in the Notes data folder, backed up daily, and recoverable for 30 days after deleting the note; if the file is missing, a placeholder is drawn, and it shows again when the file is back. Titles, lists and the Note Wall mention them as “Image”, and cards with images show a thumbnail of the first image at the top of the wall

changes.text: 便签和别处打通：便签开着时从剪贴板面板或启动器粘贴，内容直接落进光标处（标题框里也行），面板收起后键盘回到便签；在便签里划词翻译读的是便签里的字，「替换原文」也换回便签（那段字改过了就只复制、提醒一句）。便签能整个导出成 Markdown 文件夹、再导回来：每条一个 .md 文件，图片放在旁边的 attachments 文件夹，文件里记着编号、颜色、时间和顺序，导回导出过的文件夹不会重复，别处的 .md 每个变成一条新便签；单条便签也能从全部便签窗口、那叠里打开的便签或浮动便签的菜单里「导出为 Markdown…」，图片一起放进 attachments
changes.textEn: Notes connect with the rest of the app: with a note open, pasting from the Clipboard panel or Launcher lands right at the cursor (in the title field too), and the keyboard returns to the note when the panel closes. Translate Selection in a note reads the note’s text, and “Replace Original” puts the translation back in the note (if that text has changed, it only copies and tells you). All notes can be exported as a folder of Markdown files and imported back: one .md file per note, images in an attachments folder beside them, with IDs, colors, times and order recorded in the files, so importing a folder you exported doesn’t create duplicates, and .md files from elsewhere each become a new note. A single note can also be exported with “Export as Markdown…” from the menu in the All Notes window, a note opened from the stack or a Floating Note, with its images in attachments

changes.text: 新增三个全局快捷键：快速记一条（默认 ⌥N）、新建便签、全部便签（后两个默认没有，到 设置 › 快捷键 里设）。菜单栏、启动器、快捷键速查表里各多了「便签」一节；设置里多了「便签」一页，可以调正文的字号和行距、开关 Markdown 样式；在「全部便签」或打开的便签里按 ⌘, 直接打开这一页（「全部便签」的工具栏、便签的操作菜单里也有「便签设置」）
changes.textEn: Three new global shortcuts: Quick Note (⌥N by default), New Note and All Notes (no default for the last two; set them in Settings › Shortcuts). The menu bar, Launcher and Keyboard Shortcuts each get a “Notes” section, and Settings gets a “Notes” page for adjusting text size and line spacing and turning Markdown styling on or off; press ⌘, in “All Notes” or an open note to go straight to that page (“Note Settings” is also in the “All Notes” toolbar and the note actions menu)

changes.text: 设置 › 关于 里多了「未来计划」：接下来打算做的事都列在更新日志上面——已知的小毛病和以后要加的功能，做好了就挪进更新日志
changes.textEn: New “Roadmap” in Settings › About: what’s planned next is listed above the release notes—known small issues and features to come—and moves into the release notes once done

changes.text: 更新时能看到进度了：关于页是一条进度条加百分比，刘海上多一条细进度条，写着已下载百分之几；下载完写「正在安装」，装好照旧自动重新打开。原来从头到尾只是转圈。录屏转成 GIF、压缩时刘海上的进度也多了同样的细进度条
changes.textEn: Updates now show progress: the About page has a progress bar with a percentage, and a thin progress bar on the notch shows how much has downloaded; when the download finishes it says “Installing”, and once installed it reopens automatically as before. It used to just spin the whole time. Converting screen recordings to GIF and compressing them also get the same thin progress bar on the notch

changes.text: 长截图：一开始预览里就是选区现在的画面，不再空着；在鼠标指上去会变色的列表上慢慢滚，不再动不动报「对不上了」；滚太快断开后，滚回已经拼过的任何地方都能接上，不用找回断掉的那一屏
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture: the preview shows what’s in the selection right from the start instead of being empty; scrolling slowly over lists that change color under the pointer no longer keeps saying it lost track; after scrolling too fast breaks the capture, scrolling back to anywhere already stitched picks it up again, without hunting for the exact screen where it broke

changes.text: 标注里画得很大的矩形、椭圆，拖出来、挪动、改大小都跟手了（原来越大越卡，占满屏幕时一步要等零点几秒）
changes.textEn: Drawing, moving and resizing very large rectangles and ellipses in annotations keeps up now (the larger they were, the slower it got—a full-screen one took a few tenths of a second per step)

changes.text: 翻译原文框、剪贴板和启动器的搜索框、剪贴板的编辑对话框里现在可以按 ⇧⌘Z 重做（原来没有）；按 ⌘Z 撤销之后，搜索结果和要翻译的原文会跟着变回去（原来只有框里的字回去了）
changes.textEn: ⇧⌘Z now redoes in the translation source field, the Clipboard and Launcher search fields, and the Clipboard edit dialog (it didn’t before); after ⌘Z, search results and the text to translate go back too (only the text in the field used to)

summary: 新增状态屏：一键把所有屏幕盖上一张告示，同时挡下键盘和鼠标——擦屏幕、擦键盘，或者电脑正在跑任务、人要走开一会儿时用。自带清洁屏幕、请勿触碰、马上回来三个状态，可以改，也可以自己加；告示上是会动的立体表情。另外把所有界面的对齐、间距和叫法重新理了一遍。
summaryEn: New Status Screen: cover every display with a notice in one step while blocking the keyboard and mouse—for wiping the screen or keyboard, or stepping away while your Mac runs a task. It comes with three statuses, Clean Screen, Do Not Touch and Be Right Back, which you can edit or add to, and the notice shows an animated 3D emoji. All interfaces also got a pass on alignment, spacing and wording.

changes.text: 新增状态屏：在启动器里输状态的名字（或「状态屏」），或点菜单栏的「状态屏」进入。所有屏幕盖上一张告示，键盘、鼠标的点按和滚动、音量亮度这类键都被挡下，前台的 App 和正在跑的任务不受影响。按住 Esc 两秒退出；或者动一下鼠标，用鼠标按住屏幕底部出现的提示两秒。它是告示加防误触，不是安全措施：没设退出密码时，照着提示谁都能退出
changes.textEn: New Status Screen: type a status name (or “Status Screen”) in Launcher, or choose “Status Screen” in the menu bar. Every display is covered by a notice, and the keyboard, mouse clicks and scrolling, and keys like volume and brightness are blocked, while the app in front and running tasks carry on. Hold Esc for two seconds to exit, or move the mouse and hold the hint that appears at the bottom of the screen for two seconds. It’s a notice that prevents accidental touches, not a security measure: without an exit passcode, anyone can follow the hint and exit

changes.text: 自带三个状态：清洁屏幕（纯黑，什么都不显示，5 分钟后自己结束，适合擦屏幕和键盘）、请勿触碰（屏幕压暗、还看得见后面的窗口，屏幕常亮、电脑不睡）、马上回来（黑底大字，电脑不睡）。告示上写着几点开始、已经多久，精确到秒，数字一位一位滚着走；定了自动结束的状态显示的是还剩多久。结束时告诉你一共挡下了几次触碰
changes.textEn: Three built-in statuses: Clean Screen (solid black, shows nothing and ends by itself after 5 minutes—made for wiping the screen and keyboard), Do Not Touch (the screen is dimmed with windows still visible behind it, and the display stays on and the Mac doesn’t sleep) and Be Right Back (large text on black, and the Mac doesn’t sleep). The notice shows when it started and how long it’s been, down to the second, with digits rolling one by one; statuses that end automatically show the time left instead. When it ends, it tells you how many touches were blocked

changes.text: 告示上是会动的立体表情：举手、闹钟、沙漏、热饮、火箭、黑猫等 16 个可选。进入时表情落下弹一下、标题一个字一个字浮出来；有人碰了键盘或鼠标，标题晃一下、表情甩一下，同时浮出怎么退出。屏幕边上还会时不时探出一双眼睛看一眼：上下左右哪条边、什么时候出来都是随机的，有人碰的时候也会出来。不想要动画可以在 设置 › 状态屏 关掉「告示上的动画」
changes.textEn: The notice shows an animated 3D emoji—16 to choose from, including a raised hand, alarm clock, hourglass, hot drink, rocket and black cat. On entering, the emoji drops in with a bounce and the title floats in letter by letter; when someone touches the keyboard or mouse, the title shakes, the emoji flicks, and how to exit floats up. Every now and then a pair of eyes peeks in from the edge of the screen—which edge and when are random, and they also appear when someone touches something. To turn off the animation, turn off “Animations on the notice” in Settings › Status Screen

changes.text: 到 设置 › 快捷键 可以给状态屏设一个全局快捷键（默认没有）：按下先出一排预览卡片，用方向键或数字键选一个再进，选中的那张放大成整屏；也可以在 设置 › 状态屏 里改成按下直接进入排在最前面的状态。想防别人动电脑：进入状态屏后再锁定屏幕（按一下触控 ID 键），电脑照样不睡、任务照跑，回来解锁，状态屏就自动结束。录屏、录音进行中不能进入
changes.textEn: You can set a global shortcut for Status Screen in Settings › Shortcuts (none by default): pressing it first shows a row of preview cards; choose one with the arrow or number keys, and the selected card grows to fill the screen. Or change it in Settings › Status Screen to go straight into the first status. To keep others off your Mac, lock the screen after entering Status Screen (press the Touch ID button): the Mac still doesn’t sleep and tasks keep running, and Status Screen ends automatically when you unlock. It can’t start while recording the screen or audio

changes.text: 可以设一个退出密码（设置 › 状态屏，4–8 位数字）：设了之后，按住 Esc 两秒不会直接退出，屏幕底部先出一个密码框，输对了才退出；输错了圆点晃一下，按 Esc 不输了。密码按键盘上的数字键认，开着中文输入法也能输。到了自动结束的时间、解锁电脑回来时照旧直接结束——忘了密码，锁定屏幕再解锁就出来了
changes.textEn: You can set an exit passcode (Settings › Status Screen, 4–8 digits): once set, holding Esc for two seconds doesn’t exit right away—a passcode field appears at the bottom of the screen first, and only the right passcode exits. A wrong one makes the dots shake, and Esc gives up. Digits are read from the keyboard’s number keys, so it works with a Chinese input method on. Reaching the automatic end time or unlocking the Mac still ends it directly—if you forget the passcode, lock the screen and unlock it to get out

changes.text: 新增 设置 › 状态屏：状态可以加、删、改、拖动排序。每个状态能改标题、说明、表情、样式（熄屏 / 告示 / 透出）、电源（照常 / 不睡眠 / 屏幕常亮）和自动结束（5 分钟到 1 小时），改的时候有预览；也可以关掉「有人碰键盘或鼠标时显示怎么退出」、设退出密码。状态列表跟着设置的导出、导入和每天自动备份走
changes.textEn: New Settings › Status Screen: add, delete, edit and drag to reorder statuses. Each status can change its title, description, emoji, style (screen off / notice / see-through), power (normal / no sleep / keep display on) and automatic end (5 minutes to 1 hour), with a preview while you edit. You can also turn off “Show how to exit when someone touches the keyboard or mouse” and set an exit passcode. The status list is included in settings export, import and daily automatic backups

changes.text: 所有界面做了一遍视觉对齐。剪贴板和启动器的搜索栏、底栏现在是同一套：放大镜和输入的字在同一个位置，底栏和列表共用左右边线；同一个 ⌘K 菜单统一叫「操作」。剪贴板每行右边的来源和时间、⌘Y 大卡里的各块内容、文件预览的缩略图各自对齐到一条线上；底栏的「已复制」「已固定」是绿底白勾；对话框里的主按钮和「取消」等高
changes.textEn: Every interface got a visual alignment pass. The search bars and bottom bars of Clipboard and Launcher now share one design: the magnifying glass and typed text sit in the same place, and the bottom bar shares its side edges with the list; the ⌘K menu is called “Actions” everywhere. The source and time on the right of each Clipboard row, the sections of the ⌘Y large card, and file preview thumbnails each line up; “Copied” and “Pinned” in the bottom bar are white checkmarks on green; the primary button and “Cancel” in dialogs are the same height

changes.text: 翻译浮窗：原文框里打第一个字不再跳一下，文字和下面卡片的正文对齐；出错时的提示和服务名对齐；卡片右上角的按钮等距，词典卡和别的卡片一样紧凑。刘海岛的图标统一成彩色圆底加符号
changes.textEn: Translation window: typing the first character in the source field no longer makes it jump, and the text lines up with the text of the cards below; error messages line up with the service name; buttons in the top-right corner of cards are evenly spaced, and the dictionary card is as compact as the others. Notch icons are now colored circles with a symbol

changes.text: 录屏、录音的控制条在待录、倒数、录制之间切换时，✕ 和红色圆钮的位置不再动，控制条只往左变长；计时按当前位数留宽。因为停止钮现在落在刚点过的开始钮上，刚开始的一小段时间里点它不算，防止连点两下把刚开始的录制停掉（快捷键和菜单栏的停止照常）。录制条上关着的开关一样亮了；长截图面板的提示不再折行，按钮和别的控制条一样大，✕ 挨着 ✓
changes.textEn: When the screen and audio recording bars switch between ready, countdown and recording, the ✕ and the red button no longer move—the bar only grows to the left, and the timer reserves width for the current number of digits. Because the stop button now lands right where you just clicked start, clicks on it are ignored for a moment after starting, so a double click doesn’t stop a recording that just began (stopping with the shortcut or the menu bar works as usual). Switches that are off on the recording bar are just as bright; the hint on the Scrolling Capture panel no longer wraps, its buttons match the other bars, and ✕ sits next to ✓

changes.text: 设置各页分组下面的说明统一靠左；从列表点进详情时页头不再跳；一行设置的说明统一成紧跟标题的小字；列表里的开关、成排的单选、状态屏「电源」的三段都回到一样的大小和位置（第三项改叫「屏幕常亮」）。深色外观下「开会」「黑猫」两个表情的小图标垫了浅底
changes.textEn: Descriptions under groups on every Settings page are aligned to the left; page headers no longer jump when you click from a list into details; descriptions for a settings row are now small text right under its title; switches in lists, rows of radio buttons and the three-part Status Screen “Power” control are back to the same size and position (the third option is now called “Keep display on”). In Dark Mode, the small icons for the “Meeting” and “Black Cat” emoji get a light background

changes.text: 修复长截图面板底部的按钮偶尔整行偏左的问题
changes.textEn: Fixed the buttons at the bottom of the Scrolling Capture panel occasionally shifting left as a whole row

summary: 剪贴板历史、翻译历史条目很多时，选中的高亮不再和条目错开，上下键切换和滚动也不再越往下越卡；关闭面板时不再泛白闪一下；翻译服务加到 10 个以上也都能在列表里看到，用 OpenCode 的地址翻译不再报错；「呼出面板时挤压弹开」不再是实验功能；剪贴板历史可以设成点一下条目就粘贴；有新版本时菜单栏图标和面板底栏会一直标着，不再一闪而过；设置、快捷键、翻译服务，连同片段、收藏和生词本，可以导出成一个文件，换电脑或重装后导回来；启动器输入 port 能看哪些端口被占着、是谁占的，顺手结束它；常驻内存少了几十 MB。
summaryEn: With many items in Clipboard History or translation history, the selection highlight no longer drifts away from the items, and the arrow keys and scrolling no longer get slower the further down you go. Panels no longer flash white when they close. With more than 10 translation services, all of them show in the list, and translating with an OpenCode address no longer fails. “Push panels in with a squeeze” is no longer experimental. Clipboard History can paste with a single click. When a new version is available, the menu bar icon and panel bottom bars keep showing it instead of a brief flash. Settings, shortcuts and Translation Services, along with Snippets, Favorites and Word List, can be exported to one file and imported on a new Mac or after reinstalling. Type port in Launcher to see which ports are in use and by whom, and end the process if you want. Resident memory is down by tens of MB.

changes.text: 设置 › 通用新增「导出与导入」：把各页的设置、全局快捷键、翻译服务、网页搜索与快捷链接，连同片段、文字类的收藏和收藏夹、生词本存成一个文件，换电脑或重装后导回来，导出和导入都能只选其中几类；片段、收藏和生词导入时是合并，不会删掉或重复已有的（图片、文件类的收藏和普通历史不在文件里）；翻译服务的密钥默认不进文件，要带的话用你设的密码加密
changes.textEn: New “Export & Import” in Settings › General: save your settings from every page, global shortcuts, Translation Services, Web Search and Quicklinks, along with Snippets, text Favorites and collections, and Word List, to a single file, and import it on a new Mac or after reinstalling. You can export or import just some of the kinds. Snippets, Favorites and words are merged on import, so nothing existing is deleted or duplicated (image and file Favorites and regular history aren’t in the file). Translation service keys aren’t included by default; to include them, they’re encrypted with a password you set

changes.text: 设置和数据每天自动备份一份：设置、快捷键、翻译服务、网页搜索、片段、文字收藏和生词本每天自动存在这台 Mac 上，留最近 7 份。改乱了设置、误删了片段，到 设置 › 通用「从备份恢复」选一天找回来；还可以再选一个文件夹（比如 iCloud 云盘里的）每天多存一份，换电脑、硬盘坏了也不怕。导入之前也会先自动存一份，设置和快捷键导错了能换回去（备份里不含翻译服务的密钥；不想要可以在同一处关掉）
changes.textEn: Settings and data are backed up automatically every day: settings, shortcuts, Translation Services, Web Search, Snippets, text Favorites and Word List are saved on this Mac daily, keeping the last 7. If you mess up your settings or delete a snippet by mistake, pick a day in Settings › General › Restore from Backup to get it back. You can also choose a folder (for example in iCloud Drive) for an extra daily copy, in case you switch Macs or a drive fails. A copy is also saved automatically before importing, so settings and shortcuts imported by mistake can be switched back (backups don’t include translation service keys; you can turn backups off in the same place)

changes.text: 设置 › 剪贴板新增「单击条目直接粘贴」（默认关）：打开后在剪贴板历史里点一下条目就粘贴，不用双击；⌘ 单击、⇧ 单击照常多选
changes.textEn: New “Click an item to paste” in Settings › Clipboard (off by default): when on, a single click on an item in Clipboard History pastes it, no double-click needed; ⌘-click and ⇧-click still select multiple items

changes.text: 启动器新增 port：输入 port 加空格，列出这台 Mac 上正在监听的端口，一个端口一行，写着是哪个进程占着、它在哪个项目文件夹里（同时开着好几个 node 也分得清）；接着输端口号就只看那一个（port 3000），也能按进程名、文件夹名找。↩ 结束占用它的进程，⌘↩ 强制结束（再按一次确认）；占着端口的是程序坞里的 App 时，↩ 是正常退出
changes.textEn: New port command in Launcher: type port and a space to list the ports this Mac is listening on, one per row, showing which process holds it and which project folder it’s in (so several node processes are easy to tell apart). Add a port number to see just that one (port 3000), or search by process or folder name. ↩ ends the process holding the port, ⌘↩ force quits it (press again to confirm); when the port belongs to an app in the Dock, ↩ quits it normally

changes.text: 有新版本时更容易看到：菜单栏图标右上角多一个小圆点，剪贴板历史和启动器的底栏常驻「更新到 x」，点一下就更新并重新打开（原来只有刘海上停 2 秒的一次提示，错过就要自己去菜单里找）
changes.textEn: New versions are easier to notice: a small dot appears at the top right of the menu bar icon, and the bottom bars of Clipboard History and Launcher keep showing “Update to x”—click it to update and reopen (there used to be only a 2-second notice on the notch, and if you missed it you had to find it in the menu)

changes.text: 剪贴板历史条目很多时，选中的高亮不再和条目错开（拖动滚动条、在第一条按 ↑ 跳到最后一条之后最明显）
changes.textEn: With many items in Clipboard History, the selection highlight no longer drifts away from the items (most noticeable after dragging the scroll bar, or pressing ↑ on the first item to jump to the last)

changes.text: 剪贴板历史条目很多时，上下键切换和滚动不再越往下越卡：几百条之后按一下方向键原来要几百毫秒，现在和条目多少无关
changes.textEn: With many items in Clipboard History, the arrow keys and scrolling no longer get slower the further down you go: after a few hundred items an arrow key press used to take hundreds of milliseconds, and now it doesn’t depend on how many items there are

changes.text: 剪贴板历史、启动器、翻译浮窗少占内存：三块面板呼出过之后各少占约 10 MB，深色外观下每张翻译结果卡再少 2–3 MB（原来面板边上那条 1 pt 的高光线被画成了整块面板那么大的图，面板收起后也一直占着）
changes.textEn: Clipboard History, Launcher and the translation window use less memory: about 10 MB less each once opened, and 2–3 MB less per translation card in Dark Mode (the 1 pt highlight along the panel edge was drawn as an image the size of the whole panel, and kept its memory after the panel closed)

changes.text: 闲着的时候把内存还回去：剪贴板历史、启动器、翻译浮窗都收起两分钟后，清掉看过的图片预览（看得多时有约 50 MB）和链接预览的头图（看过十来条链接时有约 70 MB）、放掉识字和截图翻译用过的识字模型（约 50 MB）、把用完的内存还给系统；再打开时图片预览和链接头图重新生成，一闪就好（链接不用重新联网），隔了两分钟以上再识字第一次会慢零点几秒
changes.textEn: Memory is given back when idle: two minutes after Clipboard History, Launcher and the translation window are all closed, viewed image previews (about 50 MB after viewing many) and link preview images (about 70 MB after a dozen links) are cleared, the text recognition model used by Capture Text and Translate Screenshot (about 50 MB) is released, and unused memory goes back to the system. Next time, image previews and link images are regenerated in a blink (links aren’t fetched again), and the first text capture after more than two minutes takes a few tenths of a second longer

changes.text: 翻译历史条目很多时同样修好：选中的高亮不再和条目错开，滚动和上下键也不再越往下越卡
changes.textEn: Fixed the same issues with many items in translation history: the selection highlight no longer drifts away from the items, and scrolling and the arrow keys no longer get slower the further down you go

changes.text: AI 服务填 OpenCode（opencode.ai）的地址时，翻译和「测试连接」不再报「请求失败（400）：Request is missing x-opencode-session」
changes.textEn: With an OpenCode (opencode.ai) address in an AI service, translating and “Test Connection” no longer fail with “Request failed (400): Request is missing x-opencode-session”

changes.text: 关闭剪贴板历史、启动器、翻译浮窗时，面板不再先泛白闪一下再消失（深色外观下背后是深色窗口时最明显），现在平滑淡出
changes.textEn: Closing Clipboard History, Launcher or the translation window no longer flashes the panel white before it disappears (most noticeable in Dark Mode over dark windows); it now fades out smoothly

changes.text: ⌘K 菜单和剪贴板的筛选面板里，用 ↑↓ 选到一组的第一项（比如最下面的「删除」）时菜单会跟着滚到它；原来只滚出它上面那条分隔线，选中的那一项还在菜单外面看不到
changes.textEn: In the ⌘K menu and the Clipboard filter panel, selecting the first item of a group with ↑↓ (such as “Delete” at the bottom) scrolls the menu to it; it used to scroll only far enough to show the separator above, leaving the selected item out of view

changes.text: 删除、清空、移到废纸篓、强制退出这类操作统一用红色标出来：⌘K 菜单里的「删除」「清空历史…」「移到废纸篓」，剪贴板多选时底栏的「删除」，设置里的「删除…」「清空…」按钮；启动器里等着再按一次确认的命令，底栏的「确认…」和 ↩ 键帽也换成红色
changes.textEn: Delete, clear, move to Trash, force quit and similar actions are now marked in red: “Delete”, “Clear History…” and “Move to Trash” in the ⌘K menu, “Delete” in the Clipboard bottom bar when several items are selected, and the “Delete…” and “Clear…” buttons in Settings; for Launcher commands waiting for a second press to confirm, the “Confirm…” in the bottom bar and the ↩ keycap turn red too

changes.text: 翻译服务超过 10 个时，第 11 个起在列表里看不到、也滚不过去（新加的服务像是没存上）：现在有几个列几个，跟着整页一起滚；剪贴板「排除的 App」、启动器「网页搜索」两个列表同样修好
changes.textEn: With more than 10 translation services, the 11th and later couldn’t be seen or scrolled to (new services looked like they hadn’t been saved): now every service is listed and scrolls with the page; the Clipboard “Excluded Apps” and Launcher “Web Search” lists are fixed the same way

changes.text: AI 服务的模型下拉里，很长的模型名不再折成两行：一行一个，放不下的末尾用省略号
changes.textEn: Long model names in the AI service model menu no longer wrap onto two lines: one per line, truncated with an ellipsis when they don’t fit

changes.text: 「呼出面板时挤压弹开」不再是实验功能：挪到 设置 › 通用 单独的「动效」一组，默认仍关
changes.textEn: “Push panels in with a squeeze” is no longer experimental: it moved to its own “Motion” group in Settings › General, still off by default

summary: 更省电、更省内存，录屏文件能变小：用大模型翻译时耗电少了很多，看过很多图片后内存不再一直涨；录屏可以选清晰度和编码，录好的视频能压缩，显示按键也能只显示快捷键。片段、收藏和生词本每天自动备份，数据坏了能找回来；还能一键把剪贴板里的图钉到屏幕上。
summaryEn: Lighter on battery and memory, and smaller screen recordings: translating with AI models uses much less power, and memory no longer keeps growing after viewing lots of images. Screen recordings can choose sharpness and codec, finished videos can be compressed, and showing keystrokes can show only shortcuts. Snippets, Favorites and Word List are backed up automatically every day, so they can be recovered if the data gets damaged. And an image on the clipboard can be pinned to the screen in one step.

changes.text: 用大模型翻译时更省电：还没出字、在思考的那段时间，卡片边框上转圈的光和扫光换了更省的画法，CPU 占用降到原来的五分之一左右；出字过程中 CPU 占用降了一半多，出字到一半停住等下一批字时降得更多
changes.textEn: Translating with AI models uses less power: while the model is thinking before any text appears, the spinning glow and shimmer on the card border are drawn more efficiently, cutting CPU use to about a fifth; while text streams in, CPU use is down by more than half, and even more while it waits for the next batch of text

changes.text: 大模型出字时，译文末尾那根一明一暗的光标现在能显示了（以前一直没画出来），出完就消失
changes.textEn: While an AI model streams text, the blinking cursor at the end of the translation now shows up (it was never drawn before), and disappears when it’s done

changes.text: 翻译历史里的时间，分钟不到 10 时不再少一个 0（以前 18:07 会显示成「18:7」）
changes.textEn: Times in translation history no longer drop the leading zero for minutes under 10 (18:07 used to show as “18:7”)

changes.text: 看过很多图片、用过放大预览（⌘Y）之后，占用的内存不再一直往上涨：预览图只留最近看过的那些，放大预览关掉后会把它占的内存还回去（启动器里按 ⌘Y 看文件也一样）
changes.textEn: Memory no longer keeps growing after viewing lots of images and using the large preview (⌘Y): only recently viewed previews are kept, and the large preview gives its memory back when closed (the same goes for ⌘Y on files in Launcher)

changes.text: 复制图片后识别图里的文字，不再让占用的内存涨上去一截就不回落（识别改在一个用完就退出的后台进程里做，速度和原来一样）
changes.textEn: Recognizing text in a copied image no longer leaves memory a notch higher for good (recognition now runs in a background process that exits when done, just as fast as before)

changes.text: 录屏文件嫌大：设置 › 录制「录屏」可以选清晰度（标准：高分屏上宽高各减半，文件小一半多）和编码（HEVC：同样的画面小三分之一左右，部分 App 和旧设备可能放不了）；默认不变
changes.textEn: If screen recordings are too big: Settings › Recording › Record Screen lets you choose sharpness (Standard halves the width and height on high-resolution displays, making files less than half the size) and codec (HEVC makes the same footage about a third smaller, though some apps and older devices may not play it); defaults are unchanged

changes.text: 录好的视频可以压缩：鼠标移到角落的视频缩略图上点右下角的「压缩」（右键菜单里也有），另存一个更小的文件、原文件不动，通常能小一半以上（画面一直在动的能小到四分之一左右），文字照样清楚
changes.textEn: Finished videos can be compressed: move the pointer over the video thumbnail in the corner and click “Compress” at the bottom right (also in the right-click menu) to save a smaller copy while leaving the original untouched—usually less than half the size (down to about a quarter for footage that’s always moving), with text still sharp

changes.text: 显示按键可以只显示快捷键：设置 › 录制「显示按键时」选「只显示快捷键」，带 ⌘ ⌃ ⌥ 的组合键、Esc 和 F 键才进画面，打字不显示
changes.textEn: Showing keystrokes can show only shortcuts: in Settings › Recording, set “When showing keystrokes” to “Shortcuts only”, and only combinations with ⌘ ⌃ ⌥, Esc and the F-keys appear in the recording, not typing

changes.text: 转成 GIF、压缩的时候，屏幕顶上的提示里有百分比
changes.textEn: Converting to GIF and compressing show a percentage in the notice at the top of the screen

changes.text: 识字、截图翻译识别得慢时先提示「识别中」，结果出来再换成结果；很快识完的不闪这一下
changes.textEn: When Capture Text or Translate Screenshot is slow to recognize, “Recognizing” shows first and is replaced by the result; quick recognitions don’t flash it

changes.text: 新增「钉住剪贴板里的图」：复制一张图片（或在访达里复制一个图片文件）后，一步就能把它钉在屏幕中央，不用先打开剪贴板历史；连按几次会依次错开。默认没有快捷键，到 设置 › 快捷键 里设一个，也可以从菜单栏或启动器里点
changes.textEn: New “Pin Clipboard Image”: after copying an image (or an image file in Finder), pin it to the center of the screen in one step, without opening Clipboard History first; pressing it several times offsets each one. There’s no shortcut by default—set one in Settings › Shortcuts, or choose it from the menu bar or Launcher

changes.text: 剪贴板里的图片「钉到屏幕」时会让开屏幕上已有的钉图：同一张钉两次、一次钉好几张，都依次往右下错开，不再叠在一起
changes.textEn: Pinning clipboard images to the screen now steers clear of pinned screenshots already on screen: pinning the same image twice or several at once offsets each one down and to the right instead of stacking them

changes.text: 钉图的透明度改成滑块：鼠标移到钉图上点右上角的透明度按钮（或右键「透明度」），拖动就能在 10%–100% 之间调，边拖边看效果
changes.textEn: Pinned screenshot opacity is now a slider: move the pointer over a pinned screenshot and click the opacity button at the top right (or right-click “Opacity”), then drag to set anywhere from 10% to 100% and watch it change as you drag

changes.text: 录屏、录音的设置从「截图」页挪到单独的「录制」页；保存的文件夹两页都能改，是同一个设置
changes.textEn: Screen and audio recording settings moved from the “Screenshot” page to their own “Recording” page; the save folder can be changed on either page and is the same setting

changes.text: 翻译浮窗放得下三个结果：三个服务的译文都很长时不再多出一条外层滚动条，第四个起才往下滚
changes.textEn: The translation window fits three results: when all three services return long translations, there’s no extra outer scroll bar, and scrolling starts only from the fourth

changes.text: ⌘K 动作菜单的滚动条挪到菜单最右边，不再压在菜单项上（剪贴板、启动器、翻译历史都是）
changes.textEn: The scroll bar of the ⌘K actions menu moved to the far right of the menu instead of covering menu items (in Clipboard, Launcher and translation history)

changes.text: 数据多了一道保险：片段、收藏和生词本每天自动备份一份，留最近 3 份（普通的剪贴板历史和翻译历史不进备份）；万一数据坏了打不开，启动时可以选用最近一次的备份把它们找回来，或者「重新开始」，出问题的文件会留着、不会删
changes.textEn: An extra safeguard for your data: Snippets, Favorites and Word List are backed up automatically every day, keeping the last 3 (regular clipboard and translation history aren’t backed up). If the data is ever damaged and won’t open, at launch you can recover them from the latest backup or “Start Over”, and the damaged file is kept, not deleted

summary: 新增录屏和录音：⌥R 框选录屏，可带系统声音和麦克风、开始前倒数，停下后在屏幕角落留一张视频卡，还能转成 GIF；录音可以录麦克风、系统声音或两者，存成 m4a。
summaryEn: New screen and audio recording: press ⌥R to select an area to record, with system audio and microphone and a countdown before starting; when you stop, a video card stays in the corner of the screen and can be converted to GIF. Audio recordings can capture the microphone, system audio or both, saved as m4a.

changes.text: 按 ⌥R（或菜单栏、启动器里的「录屏」）框选要录的区域，和截图同一套：单击窗口录它所在的区域、单击桌面录整屏、拖动自己框、按 D 用上次的区域；截图时按 R 或点工具栏上的录屏按钮，选好的区域直接转成录屏
changes.textEn: Press ⌥R (or choose “Record Screen” in the menu bar or Launcher) to select the area to record, the same way as screenshots: click a window to record its area, click the desktop to record the full screen, drag your own area, or press D for the previous area. While taking a screenshot, press R or click the record button on the toolbar to turn the selected area into a screen recording

changes.text: 框好后，选区下方的四个按钮可以开关系统声音、麦克风、显示点按（开着时点按处有一个明显的圈，按住拖动时跟着走，右键是空心环）和显示按键（按下的键和快捷键显示在画面底部，按住不放时写 ×次数，停手一会儿自动消失；需要辅助功能授权；按下的键会录进画面，要输密码先关掉），下次记住上次的选择（麦克风是蓝牙耳机时，提示里会说明录下来是通话音质）；按 ↩、双击选区或点 ● 开始，默认先倒数 3 秒，倒数时按 Esc 取消、点数字马上开始
changes.textEn: Once the area is selected, four buttons below it toggle system audio, microphone, show clicks (a clear ring where you click that follows while you drag, and a hollow ring for right-clicks) and show keystrokes (keys and shortcuts you press appear at the bottom, held keys show ×count, and they fade after a moment; requires Accessibility access; pressed keys are recorded, so turn it off before typing a password). Your choices are remembered for next time (when the microphone is a Bluetooth headset, the hint mentions it records at call quality). Press ↩, double-click the area or click ● to start; a 3-second countdown runs by default—press Esc to cancel or click the number to start right away

changes.text: 录制中选区外有一圈边框，控制条显示计时，✕ 要点两下才放弃，■ 停止并保存，控制条可以拖开；菜单栏多出「■ 计时」，点它或再按一次 ⌥R 也会停止；录制中照样能截图
changes.textEn: While recording, a border surrounds the area and the control bar shows a timer; ✕ needs two clicks to discard, ■ stops and saves, and the bar can be dragged aside. The menu bar shows “■ timer”, and clicking it or pressing ⌥R again also stops. You can still take screenshots while recording

changes.text: 停止后最后一帧飞到屏幕右下角，变成一张视频卡：拷贝（拷的是文件，也会记进剪贴板历史）、双击用默认 App 打开、直接拖出去、右键移到废纸篓；文件存进截图的快速保存文件夹，名字是「录屏 日期 时间.mp4」
changes.textEn: When you stop, the last frame flies to the bottom-right corner and becomes a video card: copy it (copies the file and records it in Clipboard History), double-click to open in the default app, drag it out, or right-click to move it to the Trash. The file is saved in the screenshot Quick Save folder, named with the date and time

changes.text: 视频卡上「转成 GIF」（悬停时的按钮或右键）：每秒 15 帧、宽不超过 960、最长转前 60 秒，存进同一个文件夹；转好后角落多一张 GIF 卡，同样能拷贝、打开、拖出、移到废纸篓
changes.textEn: “Convert to GIF” on the video card (the hover button or right-click): 15 frames per second, up to 960 wide, converting the first 60 seconds at most, saved in the same folder; when done, a GIF card appears in the corner that you can likewise copy, open, drag out or move to the Trash

changes.text: 锁屏、睡眠、显示器睡眠、屏幕有变化或磁盘剩余不到 1 GB 时自动停止，并保存已录的部分；录制中麦克风断开不会停，结束时提示后半段没有麦克风声音；录到一半 App 意外退出，下次打开会找回文件；录制中退出 App 会先存好再退
changes.textEn: Recording stops automatically and saves what it has when the screen locks, the Mac or display sleeps, the screen setup changes, or less than 1 GB of disk space remains. A microphone disconnecting during recording doesn’t stop it, and you’re told at the end that the rest has no microphone audio. If the app quits unexpectedly mid-recording, the file is recovered next time it opens; quitting the app while recording saves first

changes.text: 设置 › 截图新增「录屏」组：帧率（30 / 60 fps）、开始前倒数（不倒数 / 3 秒 / 5 秒）、显示光标；打开麦克风后第一次开录时才请求授权，设置 › 通用「权限」多了「麦克风」一行
changes.textEn: New “Record Screen” group in Settings › Screenshot: frame rate (30 / 60 fps), countdown before starting (none / 3 seconds / 5 seconds) and show pointer. Microphone access is requested only the first time you record with the microphone on, and Settings › General › Permissions has a new “Microphone” row

changes.text: 按录音快捷键（默认没有，可以在 设置 › 快捷键 里设）或点菜单栏、启动器里的「录音」，先在屏幕底部打开录音控制条：上面两个按钮开关系统声音和麦克风（至少留一个），点 ● 或再按一次开始；录制中控制条显示计时和音量，✕ 要点两下才放弃，点 ■ 或再按一次停止并保存，菜单栏同样有「■ 计时」
changes.textEn: Press the audio recording shortcut (none by default; set one in Settings › Shortcuts) or choose “Record Audio” in the menu bar or Launcher to open the audio recording bar at the bottom of the screen: two buttons toggle system audio and microphone (at least one stays on), and clicking ● or pressing the shortcut again starts. While recording, the bar shows a timer and the level; ✕ needs two clicks to discard, ■ or the shortcut again stops and saves, and the menu bar shows “■ timer” here too

changes.text: 设置 › 截图「录音」组：来源选麦克风（默认）、系统声音或两者都录，和控制条上的两个按钮是同一个设置；打开「按快捷键后立即开始录音」就不先出控制条，按下直接录；只录麦克风时可以暂停 / 继续，锁屏也照录；录系统声音时不能暂停，锁屏会停止
changes.textEn: “Record Audio” group in Settings › Screenshot: the source can be the microphone (default), system audio or both, the same setting as the two buttons on the bar. Turn on “Start recording right after the shortcut” to skip the bar and record immediately. Microphone-only recordings can be paused and resumed and keep recording when the screen locks; system audio recordings can’t be paused and stop when the screen locks

changes.text: 开头 5 秒麦克风一直没声音会提醒；录好的是 m4a，停止后波形飞到右下角变成一张录音卡，能拷贝、打开、拖出、移到废纸篓
changes.textEn: You’re warned if the microphone is silent for the first 5 seconds. Recordings are m4a; when you stop, the waveform flies to the bottom-right corner and becomes an audio card you can copy, open, drag out or move to the Trash

changes.text: 菜单栏、设置 › 快捷键和快捷键速查表里的「截图」一节改名「截图与录制」，多了录屏（默认 ⌥R）和录音；速查表新增录屏、录音两组按键
changes.textEn: The “Screenshot” section in the menu bar, Settings › Shortcuts and Keyboard Shortcuts is renamed “Screenshot & Recording”, adding Record Screen (⌥R by default) and Record Audio; Keyboard Shortcuts gains key groups for screen and audio recording

changes.text: 录屏和录音同时只能有一个：正在录时点另一个会提示先停止这一段；录制中暂时不能「更新并重新打开」
changes.textEn: Only one of screen or audio recording can run at a time: starting the other while recording asks you to stop the current one first. “Update and Reopen” is unavailable while recording

changes.text: 选中一行就能显示全的文本时，展开的预览不再把同一句话重复显示一遍，只在下面留一行类型、字数、时间和来源；一行显示不全的照旧展开看全文
changes.textEn: When the selected row already shows the full text, the expanded preview no longer repeats the same sentence and only adds a line with type, character count, time and source below; text that doesn’t fit on one line still expands to show it all

changes.text: ⌘Y 放大预览里的图片现在居中显示；屏幕放不下原尺寸时窗口按图片的比例缩小，不再是图片贴在右边、左边空出一大块
changes.textEn: Images in the ⌘Y large preview are now centered; when the screen can’t fit the original size, the window shrinks to the image’s proportions instead of leaving the image pressed to the right with a big gap on the left

summary: 启动器加了系统命令、kill、收藏、单位换算和网站图标；剪贴板的分组并进收藏夹、删除能连着撤销；翻译浮窗跟随鼠标出现；截图叫法统一、钉图能识字；菜单栏图标可以隐藏或换成彩色。输入翻译的默认快捷键改为 ⌥T。
summaryEn: Launcher adds system commands, kill, favorites, unit conversion and site icons; Clipboard groups merge into collections and deletions can be undone one after another; the translation window appears near the pointer; screenshot wording is unified and pinned screenshots can capture text; the menu bar icon can be hidden or shown in color. The default shortcut for Type to Translate is now ⌥T.

changes.text: 系统命令：输入 lock、sleep、restart、emptytrash、mute 等关键词（中文名、拼音也行）就能锁屏、睡眠、关闭显示器、开屏幕保护程序、清倒废纸篓、调音量、退出登录 / 重新启动 / 关机、全部退出、推出全部磁盘；清倒废纸篓和全部退出要再按一次 ↩ 确认，退出登录、重启、关机弹系统的确认框
changes.textEn: System commands: type keywords like lock, sleep, restart, emptytrash or mute (Chinese names and pinyin work too) to lock the screen, sleep, turn off the display, start the screen saver, empty the Trash, adjust volume, log out / restart / shut down, quit all apps, or eject all disks. Emptying the Trash and quitting all apps need a second ↩ to confirm, and log out, restart and shut down show the system’s confirmation

changes.text: 输入「quit」「hide」「forcequit」「eject」加空格，列出正在运行的 App 或可推出的磁盘，↩ 退出 / 隐藏 / 强制退出 / 推出；quit 和 hide 里 ⌘↩ 也是强制退出，强制退出都要再按一次确认
changes.textEn: Type “quit”, “hide”, “forcequit” or “eject” and a space to list running apps or ejectable disks; ↩ quits / hides / force quits / ejects. In quit and hide, ⌘↩ also force quits, and force quitting always needs a second press to confirm

changes.text: 输入「kill」加空格列出后台进程（名字、PID、内存、监听的端口），「kill :3000」按端口找；↩ 结束，⌘↩ 强制结束（再按一次确认）
changes.textEn: Type “kill” and a space to list background processes (name, PID, memory, listening ports), or “kill :3000” to find by port; ↩ ends the process and ⌘↩ force quits it (press again to confirm)

changes.text: 收藏：选中一项按 ⌘D（或 ⌘K「加入收藏」），最多 8 个，空输入时排在最前，⌥⌘↑↓ 调顺序；原来的「最近使用」改名「常用」，在「常用」里 ⌘⌫ 移除后可以 ⌘Z 撤销
changes.textEn: Favorites: select an item and press ⌘D (or ⌘K “Add to Favorites”), up to 8, shown first when the input is empty; ⌥⌘↑↓ reorders them. “Recently Used” is renamed “Frequent”, and items removed from “Frequent” with ⌘⌫ can be restored with ⌘Z

changes.text: 计算器能换算单位（「10 km to mi」「30 摄氏度 转 华氏度」）和进制（「255 in hex」，0o 开头是八进制），结果按千分位分组，⌘K 可复制原始数字、十六进制或二进制；中文输入法打出的全角数字和 × ÷ 也认
changes.textEn: The calculator converts units (“10 km to mi”, in Chinese too) and number bases (“255 in hex”; a leading 0o means octal), with results grouped by thousands; ⌘K copies the raw number, hexadecimal or binary. Full-width digits and × ÷ typed with a Chinese input method work too

changes.text: 计算器里的 % 改为百分比（200*15% = 30、100+10% = 110），取余数改用 mod
changes.textEn: In the calculator, % now means percent (200*15% = 30, 100+10% = 110); use mod for remainders

changes.text: 直接搜系统设置里的面板（蓝牙、显示器、隐私与安全性等），↩ 跳到对应的设置页
changes.textEn: Search panes in System Settings directly (Bluetooth, Displays, Privacy & Security and more), and ↩ jumps to that settings page

changes.text: 设置 › 启动器「浏览器书签与历史」只列本机装了的浏览器，新增 Safari、Firefox、Arc 等（Safari 要在系统设置里给「完全磁盘访问权限」，没给时那一行会提示并带「去授权…」）；每家都可以打开「也搜浏览历史」（默认关），常去的页面排在书签后面；每一行写明读到了多少条
changes.textEn: Settings › Launcher › “Browser bookmarks & history” lists only browsers installed on this Mac, adding Safari, Firefox, Arc and more (Safari needs Full Disk Access in System Settings; without it, that row says so and offers “Allow Access…”). Each browser can also “Search browsing history” (off by default), with frequently visited pages after bookmarks, and each row shows how many items were read

changes.text: 网址、书签、浏览历史和网页搜索显示网站自己的图标（只用本机浏览器里已有的图标，不联网）
changes.textEn: URLs, bookmarks, browsing history and Web Search show each site’s own icon (using only icons already in browsers on this Mac, never going online)

changes.text: 输入「fy 要翻译的文字」按 ↩ 直接打开翻译浮窗翻译；只输一个英文单词时，副标题就是词典的第一条释义
changes.textEn: Type “fy” followed by text and press ↩ to translate it in the translation window right away; for a single English word, the subtitle shows the first dictionary definition

changes.text: 文件的 ⌘K 动作加了「快速查看」（⌘Y）、用其他 App 打开（默认的排第一）和「移到废纸篓」；网址可以用其他浏览器打开（第一个是 ⌘↩），还有「复制为 Markdown 链接」（⇧⌘C）和「复制标题」；光标在末尾时按 → 或在结果上点右键，都能打开同一份动作菜单
changes.textEn: ⌘K actions for files add “Quick Look” (⌘Y), open with another app (the default first) and “Move to Trash”; URLs can open in another browser (⌘↩ for the first), with “Copy as Markdown Link” (⇧⌘C) and “Copy Title”. Pressing → with the cursor at the end or right-clicking a result opens the same actions menu

changes.text: 菜单栏里的每一项都能在启动器里搜到并运行：截取上次区域、划词翻译并替换、暂停记录剪贴板、复制即译、显示 / 隐藏 / 关闭全部钉图、快捷键速查表、关于、检查更新
changes.textEn: Every menu bar item can be found and run in Launcher: Capture Previous Area, Translate and Replace Selection, Pause Clipboard Recording, Translate on Copy, show / hide / close all pinned screenshots, Keyboard Shortcuts, About and Check for Updates

changes.text: 没执行就收起的话，60 秒内再呼出会保留上次的输入和选中项（文字全选，直接打字就替换）
changes.textEn: If Launcher closes without running anything, bringing it back within 60 seconds keeps your last input and selection (with the text selected, so typing replaces it)

changes.text: 网页搜索默认只让 Google 在没有结果时兜底，Bing、百度改为只用关键词（自己改过列表的不变）
changes.textEn: By default, Web Search lets only Google step in when there are no results; Bing and Baidu now work by keyword only (lists you changed stay as they are)

changes.text: 「应用程序」文件夹里的 App 不再写副标题，放在别处的写出所在位置，方便分清两份同名的 App
changes.textEn: Apps in the Applications folder no longer show a subtitle; apps elsewhere show their location, making two apps with the same name easy to tell apart

changes.text: 打开 App、文件、网址时启动器立刻收起、在后台打开，不再等对方启动完；新装的 App 第一次呼出就能搜到
changes.textEn: Opening apps, files and URLs closes Launcher immediately and opens them in the background instead of waiting for them to launch; newly installed apps can be found the first time you open it

changes.text: 修复：带端口或路径的开发域名（如 app.test:3000）不认作网址、http 开头的输入不再兜底、只输 cb 时独占整个列表且区分大小写、短输入时系统命令压过同分的 App、大写锁定开着时 ⌘ 快捷键失灵、结果多时按 ↑↓ 列表不跟着滚
changes.textEn: Fixed: development domains with a port or path (like app.test:3000) not recognized as URLs, input starting with http still falling back to search, typing just cb taking over the whole list and being case-sensitive, system commands outranking equally scored apps for short input, ⌘ shortcuts failing with Caps Lock on, and the list not scrolling with ↑↓ when there were many results

changes.text: 分组并进收藏：收藏就是默认收藏夹，原来的分组改叫收藏夹，用 ⌘K「移到收藏夹 ›」归类；「管理收藏夹」改成键盘列表（↑↓ 选、↩ 改名、拖动排序、⌘⌫ 删除可 ⌘Z）
changes.textEn: Groups merge into Favorites: Favorites is the default collection, the old groups are now collections, and ⌘K “Move to Collection ›” files items; “Manage Collections” is now a keyboard list (↑↓ to choose, ↩ to rename, drag to reorder, ⌘⌫ to delete with ⌘Z to undo)

changes.text: ⌘⌫ 删除后，收起面板前都能按 ⌘Z 一批一批连着撤销；删掉后再复制同样的内容会拿回原来那条
changes.textEn: After deleting with ⌘⌫, ⌘Z undoes deletions batch by batch until the panel closes; copying the same content again after deleting brings back the original item

changes.text: 设置 › 剪贴板的保留设置合并为一行「保留普通历史」：1 天到永久（默认 1 周），不再有条数上限；「图片最多占用」只算普通图片，收藏和片段里的图片不会被挤掉
changes.textEn: Clipboard retention settings in Settings › Clipboard are merged into a single “Keep regular history” row: 1 day to forever (1 week by default), with no item limit anymore; “Maximum image storage” counts only regular images, so images in Favorites and Snippets are never pushed out

changes.text: 文本格式总是记下来；设置里的「保留文本格式」改为「默认粘贴为纯文本」（默认关，打开后 ↩ 粘纯文本、⌥↩ 保留格式）
changes.textEn: Text formatting is always recorded; “Keep text formatting” in Settings is now “Paste as plain text by default” (off by default; when on, ↩ pastes plain text and ⌥↩ keeps formatting)

changes.text: 所有条目都能写备注（⌘K 或右键「备注…」），取消收藏不再清掉备注；片段可以「移出片段」，⌘N 新建片段时可以起个名字方便搜索
changes.textEn: Every item can have a note (⌘K or right-click “Note…”), and unfavoriting no longer clears the note; snippets can be removed from Snippets, and new snippets made with ⌘N can be given a name for searching

changes.text: 片段占位符新增 {time}、{datetime}、{weekday}、{uuid} 和 {clipboard:N}（历史里第 N 条文本）；多选合并粘贴时片段里的占位符也会展开
changes.textEn: New snippet placeholders {time}, {datetime}, {weekday}, {uuid} and {clipboard:N} (the Nth text item in history); placeholders in snippets also expand when pasting several items merged together

changes.text: 文件条目 ⌘O 打开、⌘R 在访达中显示、⌥⌘C 复制路径，链接 ⌘O 打开，⌘T 翻译选中的条目；图片可以「钉到屏幕」；条目能直接拖进别的 App
changes.textEn: For file items, ⌘O opens, ⌘R shows in Finder and ⌥⌘C copies the path; ⌘O opens links, and ⌘T translates the selected item; images can be pinned to the screen; items can be dragged straight into other apps

changes.text: ⌘K 菜单分节、收藏夹收进子列表（→ 进、← 回），过滤能用拼音首字母（输 fy 找到「翻译」），右键菜单和 ⌘K 是同一份；JSON 默认美化显示
changes.textEn: The ⌘K menu is divided into sections, with collections in a submenu (→ to enter, ← to go back); filtering works with pinyin initials (fy finds “翻译”, Translate); the right-click menu and ⌘K are the same; JSON is formatted by default

changes.text: 搜索只做过滤，结果照样按天分组、标题后写命中条数；⌘C 复制的条目在收起面板时才挪到最前
changes.textEn: Search only filters: results are still grouped by day, with the match count after each heading; items copied with ⌘C move to the top only when the panel closes

changes.text: 菜单栏「暂停记录剪贴板」可以临时不记录（重启后自动恢复）；设置 › 剪贴板「不记录这些 App 里的复制」改成 App 列表，点「+」从正在运行的 App 或「应用程序」里挑
changes.textEn: “Pause Clipboard Recording” in the menu bar stops recording for a while (resumes automatically after a restart); “Don’t record copies from these apps” in Settings › Clipboard is now an app list—click “+” to pick from running apps or Applications

changes.text: 本 App 给出的新文字（译文、计算结果、路径、网址、取色、识字等）复制时也会记进剪贴板历史
changes.textEn: New text produced by this app (translations, calculation results, paths, URLs, picked colors, captured text and more) is also recorded in Clipboard History when copied

changes.text: 修复：多选文件 ⌘C 只复制了第一个（现在 ⌘C 和 ↩ 都一次带上全部文件）、依次粘贴顺序反了且文本之间没换行；删除后选中跳回第一条；搜索后批量操作打到看不见的勾选项；改了正文后仍打开旧链接；另外能跳过更多密码管理器标记和密钥格式，来源 App 认得更准（从其他设备接力来的写「其他设备」）
changes.textEn: Fixed: ⌘C on several selected files copying only the first (⌘C and ↩ now both take all the files), pasting in sequence in reverse order without line breaks between texts, the selection jumping back to the first item after deleting, batch actions after searching hitting checked items you couldn’t see, and opening the old link after editing the text. More password manager markers and key formats are skipped, and source apps are identified more accurately (items handed off from other devices say “Other Device”)

changes.text: 输入翻译的默认快捷键由 ⇧⌘I 改为 ⌥T，和其它功能一样是 ⌥ 加一个键（自己设过的不变）；浮窗开着时再按一次就收起，再打开会保留上次的原文和译文
changes.textEn: The default shortcut for Type to Translate changed from ⇧⌘I to ⌥T, matching the other features with ⌥ plus one key (shortcuts you set yourself are unchanged); pressing it again while the window is open closes it, and reopening keeps the last source text and translation

changes.text: 设置 › 翻译新增「浮窗位置」：划词、截图翻译、复制即译时默认跟随鼠标出现在光标旁边，也可以选「上次位置」
changes.textEn: New “Window position” in Settings › Translate: for Translate Selection, Translate Screenshot and Translate on Copy, the window appears next to the pointer by default, or you can choose “Last position”

changes.text: 复制即译不再翻网址、路径、纯数字和本来就是第一语言的文字；复制即译弹出的那次不自动复制译文，划词、输入、截图翻译照设置自动复制
changes.textEn: Translate on Copy no longer translates URLs, paths, plain numbers or text already in your first language; translations brought up by Translate on Copy aren’t auto-copied, while Translate Selection, Type to Translate and Translate Screenshot auto-copy as set

changes.text: 收藏的快捷键统一为 ⌘D，翻译浮窗和翻译历史里的 ⌘S 不再是收藏
changes.textEn: The Favorites shortcut is now ⌘D everywhere; ⌘S in the translation window and translation history no longer adds to Favorites

changes.text: 翻译历史里按 ⌘K（或光标在末尾时按 →）打开动作菜单：重新翻译、复制、收藏、删除、导出、清空；「⋯」菜单也能导出，设置 › 翻译新增「清空翻译历史…」
changes.textEn: Press ⌘K in translation history (or → with the cursor at the end) to open the actions menu: Retranslate, Copy, Favorite, Delete, Export and Clear; the “⋯” menu can export too, and Settings › Translate adds “Clear Translation History…”

changes.text: 设置 › 翻译「历史最多保留」改为 1000 条 / 5000 条 / 不限（默认 5000，旧的档位往上换到最近的一档，不会少留），历史列表不再只显示最近 200 条
changes.textEn: “Keep history up to” in Settings › Translate is now 1,000 / 5,000 / unlimited items (5,000 by default; old settings move up to the nearest option, so nothing is kept for less), and the history list no longer shows only the latest 200

changes.text: 「+ › AI 服务」里有常见厂商的预设，地址和协议都填好了，只剩填密钥、选模型；模型框会列出服务端能用的模型；内置服务可以删掉，需要时在「+」里加回来；常见厂商显示自己的 logo，其他自建服务自动用官网图标
changes.textEn: “+ › AI Service” has presets for common providers with the address and protocol filled in, leaving just the key and model; the model field lists the models the server offers. Built-in services can be deleted and added back from “+” when needed; common providers show their own logos, and other self-hosted services use their website icon automatically

changes.text: 识字和翻译用同一套分段：按行距分段、同一段里的行接起来（中日文不加空格）；截图翻译总是按段翻，识字在设置 › 截图打开「识字后把同一段里的换行接起来」才接
changes.textEn: Capture Text and Translate share the same paragraph splitting: paragraphs are split by line spacing and lines within a paragraph are joined (without spaces for Chinese and Japanese). Translate Screenshot always translates by paragraph, while Capture Text joins lines only when “Join line breaks within a paragraph after capturing text” is on in Settings › Screenshot

changes.text: 密钥、地址、模型这类配置问题的错误卡是橙色，点「打开设置」直达那个服务；网络和服务出错是红色，点「重试」；百度、有道的错误码写成中文说明
changes.textEn: Error cards for configuration problems such as keys, addresses and models are orange, and “Open Settings” goes straight to that service; network and service errors are red, with “Retry”; Baidu and Youdao error codes are explained in words

changes.text: 大模型「思考中」有扫光，重新翻译时正文交叉淡变，交换语言时两个语言胶囊互换位置
changes.textEn: AI models show a shimmer while “Thinking”, the text cross-fades when retranslating, and the two language capsules swap places when you swap languages

changes.text: 长文超出服务单次输出上限时，卡片写明「只翻了前一部分」，不再悄悄变短；内置智谱的第二个模型换成免费的纯文本模型 glm-4.7-flash
changes.textEn: When a long text exceeds a service’s output limit, the card says “Only the first part was translated” instead of quietly getting shorter; the second model of the built-in Zhipu service is now the free text-only model glm-4.7-flash

changes.text: 修复：在本 App 自己的窗口里 ⌘C 也会触发复制即译、收起浮窗后还在朗读、划词没取到文字时只给一个空白输入框（现在写明原因）、「划词翻译并替换」取词时取消后「翻译中」提示挂很久
changes.textEn: Fixed: ⌘C in this app’s own windows triggering Translate on Copy, reading aloud continuing after the window closed, an empty input field when Translate Selection got no text (it now explains why), and the “Translating” notice lingering after canceling while Translate and Replace Selection was reading the selection

changes.text: 叫法统一为「拷贝 / 存储到「桌面」/ 另存为…」，「存储到」写访达里显示的文件夹名；识字和截图翻译在各处用同一个图标
changes.textEn: Wording is unified as “Copy / Save to “Desktop” / Save As…”, with “Save to” showing the folder name as Finder shows it; Capture Text and Translate Screenshot use the same icon everywhere

changes.text: 「另存为」不再改掉 ⌘S 快速保存的文件夹；设置 › 截图「快速保存到」显示文件夹图标和名字，改过后可以「恢复默认」
changes.textEn: “Save As” no longer changes the ⌘S Quick Save folder; “Quick save to” in Settings › Screenshot shows the folder icon and name, and offers “Restore Default” once changed

changes.text: 钉图上 ⌘S 快速保存、⇧⌘S 另存为；按 O 或右键「识字并拷贝」，右键还能「翻译」
changes.textEn: Pinned screenshots: ⌘S quick saves and ⇧⌘S saves as; press O or right-click “Capture Text and Copy”, and right-click also offers “Translate”

changes.text: 设置 › 截图新增「截图后在屏幕角落留缩略图」（默认开，关掉后截完只在右下角闪一下）
changes.textEn: New “Keep a thumbnail in the corner after capture” in Settings › Screenshot (on by default; when off, captures just flash briefly in the bottom-right corner)

changes.text: 长截图时压在选区上的钉图、缩略图和剪贴板大卡片会让开，不再挡住滚轮和自动滚动；滚到底、到顶或到最长时不再显示成出错；选区太矮按 S 时会说明原因
changes.textEn: During Scrolling Capture, pinned screenshots, thumbnails and the large Clipboard card over the selection move out of the way instead of blocking the scroll wheel and auto-scroll; reaching the bottom, top or maximum length is no longer shown as an error; pressing S with a selection that’s too short explains why

changes.text: 多块屏幕同时定格画面，按下截图快捷键后遮罩出来得更快
changes.textEn: Screens are frozen on all displays at once, so the overlay appears faster after you press the screenshot shortcut

changes.text: 三块面板的「固定」统一为只管点别处不收起，Esc、⌘W、再按一次快捷键照样收起；剪贴板面板按 ⌘P 切换固定，设置里重复的「点击面板外部时关闭」去掉了
changes.textEn: “Pin” on all three panels now only means they don’t close when you click elsewhere; Esc, ⌘W and the shortcut again still close them. ⌘P toggles pinning on the Clipboard panel, and the duplicate “Close when clicking outside the panel” setting is gone

changes.text: 更新后不再自动打开设置窗，改为刘海里提示「已更新到 x」和一句摘要，完整内容在「关于」
changes.textEn: After updating, the Settings window no longer opens automatically; instead the notch shows “Updated to x” with a one-line summary, and the full notes are in About

changes.text: 欢迎引导里可以直接勾选「登录时自动打开」；在剪贴板、启动器里按 ⌘, 直接打开对应的设置页
changes.textEn: You can check “Open at login” right in first-run setup; press ⌘, in Clipboard or Launcher to open the matching settings page

changes.text: 设置 › 通用可以隐藏菜单栏图标，快捷键照常能用；隐藏后在启动器或访达里再打开一次 Kitty Tools 就回到设置，启动器里新增「退出 Kitty Tools」
changes.textEn: Settings › General can hide the menu bar icon while shortcuts keep working; once hidden, opening Kitty Tools again from Launcher or Finder brings up Settings, and Launcher adds “Quit Kitty Tools”

changes.text: 菜单栏图标可选单色或彩色（彩色就是 App 图标），在设置 › 通用「图标样式」里换，立刻生效
changes.textEn: The menu bar icon can be monochrome or color (color is the app icon); change it in Settings › General › Icon style, effective immediately

changes.text: 「呼出时挤压弹开（实验）」从 设置 › 启动器 挪到 设置 › 通用，改叫「呼出面板时挤压弹开」，剪贴板、启动器和翻译浮窗都用它；之前开过的保持开着
changes.textEn: “Push in with a squeeze when shown (experimental)” moved from Settings › Launcher to Settings › General as “Push panels in with a squeeze”, used by Clipboard, Launcher and the translation window; if it was on, it stays on

changes.text: 录快捷键时不接受 ⌘C、⌘V 这类通用编辑键并说明原因；设置侧栏和菜单栏同一个顺序，侧栏搜索认得新叫法（常用、收藏、浮窗位置等）
changes.textEn: Recording a shortcut no longer accepts common editing keys like ⌘C and ⌘V, and explains why; the Settings sidebar follows the same order as the menu bar, and sidebar search understands the new names (Frequent, Favorites, Window position and more)

changes.text: 主按钮的文字颜色跟着强调色走；打开「增强对比度」时分隔线和选中高亮加粗描边；使用旁白时，复制、收藏、删除、钉图这些看不见的结果都会念出来
changes.textEn: The text color of primary buttons follows the accent color; with “Increase contrast” on, separators and selection highlights get bolder outlines; with VoiceOver, results you can’t see—copy, favorite, delete, pin—are read aloud

summary: Kitty Tools 的第一个正式版：剪贴板历史、启动器、翻译和截图四合一的菜单栏工具，只支持 Apple 芯片、macOS 15 及以上。
summaryEn: The first release of Kitty Tools: Clipboard History, Launcher, Translate and Screenshot in one menu bar app, for Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later.

changes.text: 默认 ⌥C 呼出剪贴板历史：记录文本（保留格式）、图片和文件，同样内容再复制只挪到最前；收藏、片段和已归组的条目不会被自动清理
changes.textEn: ⌥C brings up Clipboard History by default: it records text (with formatting), images and files, and copying the same content again just moves it to the top; Favorites, Snippets and grouped items are never cleaned up automatically

changes.text: 键盘优先：↩ 或双击粘贴回原 App，⌥↩ 粘贴为纯文本，⌘↩ 仅复制，⌘1–9 直接粘贴第几条；多选后一起粘贴（多段文本合成一段），⌘⌫ 删除后 5 秒内可 ⌘Z 撤销
changes.textEn: Keyboard first: ↩ or double-click pastes back into the app you were in, ⌥↩ pastes as plain text, ⌘↩ only copies, and ⌘1–9 pastes that item directly; select several to paste them together (multiple texts are merged into one), and after ⌘⌫ deletes, ⌘Z undoes within 5 seconds

changes.text: 搜索同时匹配备注、文件路径、来源 App 和图片里的文字（本机识别，不联网）；Tab 按类型、颜色 / JSON / 链接 / 代码、来源 App 和分组筛选，⇧Tab 切换全部 / 收藏 / 片段
changes.textEn: Search matches notes, file paths, source apps and text in images (recognized on this Mac, never online); Tab filters by type, color / JSON / link / code, source app and group, and ⇧Tab switches between All / Favorites / Snippets

changes.text: 选中条目原地展开预览：代码语法着色、颜色值（点一下复制 HEX / RGB / HSL）、链接的网页标题和头图、图片和文件缩略图；⌘Y 放大成完整预览
changes.textEn: The selected item expands in place with a preview: syntax-colored code, color values (click to copy HEX / RGB / HSL), web page titles and images for links, and thumbnails for images and files; ⌘Y opens the full preview

changes.text: ⌘K 列出选中条目的全部操作：复制为纯文本、收藏、编辑、备注、存为片段、翻译、打开链接、美化 JSON、复制图中文字、归入分组等
changes.textEn: ⌘K lists every action for the selected item: copy as plain text, favorite, edit, note, save as snippet, translate, open link, format JSON, copy text from image, add to group and more

changes.text: 片段：⌘N 新建，支持 {date}、{clipboard}、{cursor} 占位符（{cursor} 让粘贴后光标停在那里）；收藏和片段可加备注，条目可归入分组
changes.textEn: Snippets: ⌘N creates one, with {date}, {clipboard} and {cursor} placeholders ({cursor} leaves the cursor there after pasting); Favorites and Snippets can have notes, and items can be put into groups

changes.text: 普通历史默认保留 7 天、图片最多占 512 MB，都可以改；也可设成退出 App 或锁屏时清空
changes.textEn: Regular history is kept for 7 days and images take up to 512 MB by default, both adjustable; history can also be cleared when you quit the app or lock the screen

changes.text: 跳过密码管理器标了隐私的内容，默认排除 1Password、Bitwarden、KeePass、「密码」等 App，可自己添加；自动拦截 sk- 开头的 API 密钥、Bearer Token 和银行卡号
changes.textEn: Content marked private by password managers is skipped, and apps like 1Password, Bitwarden, KeePass and Passwords are excluded by default, with more you can add; API keys starting with sk-, Bearer tokens and bank card numbers are blocked automatically

changes.text: 默认 ⌥Space 呼出：搜索并打开 App，中文名、拼音全拼 / 首字母和英文缩写都能搜到；按使用习惯排序，空输入时列出最近使用
changes.textEn: ⌥Space brings it up by default: search for and open apps by Chinese name, full pinyin or initials, and English abbreviations; results are ranked by how you use them, with recently used apps listed when the input is empty

changes.text: 直接输算式就出结果（括号、幂、sqrt / sin / log 等函数，算式里可写 0x / 0b 开头的十六 / 二进制数），↩ 粘贴回原 App，⌘C 只复制
changes.textEn: Type a calculation to get the result right away (parentheses, powers, functions like sqrt / sin / log, and hex / binary numbers starting with 0x / 0b); ↩ pastes it back into the app you were in, ⌘C only copies

changes.text: 网页搜索：「关键词 空格 内容」直达（如 g、bd、gh），可增删、拖动排序和自定义，没有本地结果时用 Google / Bing / 百度兜底；常用网址和文件夹可以起名做快捷链接
changes.textEn: Web Search: “keyword space query” goes straight there (such as g, bd, gh); searches can be added, removed, reordered and customized, with Google / Bing / Baidu stepping in when there are no local results. Frequent URLs and folders can be named as Quicklinks

changes.text: 文件搜索：「open 文件名」打开、「find 文件名」在访达中显示（桌面、文稿、下载需先授权一次）；搜 Chrome 书签（可加 Edge / Brave），输入网址或 / ~ 开头的路径直接打开
changes.textEn: File search: “open filename” opens a file and “find filename” shows it in Finder (Desktop, Documents and Downloads need access granted once); Chrome bookmarks are searchable (Edge / Brave can be added), and typing a URL or a path starting with / or ~ opens it directly

changes.text: ⌘K 列出选中项的全部动作并标出键位；输入「cb 关键词」直接到剪贴板历史里搜，截图、识字、输入翻译也能在启动器里运行
changes.textEn: ⌘K lists every action for the selected item with its keys; type “cb keyword” to search Clipboard History directly, and Take Screenshot, Capture Text and Type to Translate can run from Launcher too

changes.text: 划词翻译（默认 ⌥D）、输入翻译（默认 ⌘⇧I），复制即译可在菜单栏一键开启；开了多个服务就同时翻译，大模型的译文边生成边显示
changes.textEn: Translate Selection (⌥D by default) and Type to Translate (⌘⇧I by default), with Translate on Copy a click away in the menu bar; with several services on, they translate at the same time, and AI translations appear as they’re generated

changes.text: 内置智谱 GLM 免费额度，装好就能用；还能接百度、有道、Google、DeepL / DeepLX、微软（免密钥）、火山、腾讯，以及 OpenAI 兼容 / Azure / Anthropic 自定义大模型
changes.textEn: A free Zhipu GLM allowance is built in, so it works right after installing; you can also connect Baidu, Youdao, Google, DeepL / DeepLX, Microsoft (no key needed), Volcano Engine, Tencent, and custom OpenAI-compatible / Azure / Anthropic models

changes.text: 截图翻译（默认 ⌥S）：框选屏幕上的文字，本机识别（不联网）后交给各服务翻译，识别出的原文同时记进剪贴板历史
changes.textEn: Translate Screenshot (⌥S by default): select text on screen, and after it’s recognized on this Mac (never online) it’s sent to each service to translate; the recognized source text is also recorded in Clipboard History

changes.text: 查单个词时最上面是系统词典卡（音标、按词性分组的释义和例句），大模型也按词典格式回答
changes.textEn: When looking up a single word, a system dictionary card comes first (phonetics, definitions grouped by part of speech, and examples), and AI models answer in dictionary format too

changes.text: 目标语言可选「自动」，按设置的第一 / 第二语言互译；中英混排、单个字、短词也能认准语种
changes.textEn: The target language can be “Auto”, translating between the first and second languages you set; mixed Chinese and English, single characters and short words are recognized correctly

changes.text: 划词来的翻译可一键「替换原文」；「划词翻译并替换」不弹窗、直接把选中文字换成译文（默认不设快捷键）
