changes.textEn: Translations of a selection can “Replace Original” in one click; “Translate and Replace Selection” skips the window and replaces the selected text with the translation directly (no shortcut by default)

changes.text: 翻译历史可搜索、收藏（收藏就是生词本），可导出 CSV 或 Anki 卡片；浮窗里 ⌘1–9 复制对应译文、⌘Y 历史、⌘P 固定、⌘+ / ⌘- 调字号，可朗读、自动复制译文
changes.textEn: Translation history is searchable and can be favorited (favorites are your Word List), and exported as CSV or Anki cards; in the window, ⌘1–9 copies that translation, ⌘Y opens history, ⌘P pins, ⌘+ / ⌘- changes the text size, and translations can be read aloud and auto-copied

changes.text: 框选截图（默认 ⌥A）：按下即定格画面，弹出的菜单也截得到；悬停自动认出窗口，单击选中、双击直接复制；⌥X 直接选中上次的区域
changes.textEn: Select to capture (⌥A by default): the screen freezes the moment you press it, so open menus can be captured too; windows are detected on hover—click to select, double-click to copy right away; ⌥X selects the previous area directly

changes.text: 选区可拖边和四角、吸附窗口与屏幕边缘，⇧ 锁比例、方向键微调，可直接输入宽高；放大镜显示色值，按 C 复制
changes.textEn: Drag the selection’s edges and corners, snap to windows and screen edges, hold ⇧ to lock proportions, nudge with arrow keys, or type a width and height; the magnifier shows color values, and C copies them

changes.text: 10 种标注（数字键 1–0 切换）：矩形、椭圆、箭头、直线、画笔、荧光笔、文字、序号、马赛克、聚光灯，箭头和直线能弯成弧线；画完可再选中调整，⌘Z 撤销
changes.textEn: 10 annotation tools (switch with number keys 1–0): rectangle, ellipse, arrow, line, pen, highlighter, text, step number, mosaic and spotlight, with arrows and lines that can bend into arcs; select annotations afterward to adjust them, and ⌘Z undoes

changes.text: ↩ 复制（同时记进剪贴板历史）、⌘S 快速保存、⇧⌘S 另存为、T 钉在屏幕上、O 识字，工具栏里还能直接翻译；截完飞到右下角留下缩略图，可拖进其它 App
changes.textEn: ↩ copies (and records in Clipboard History), ⌘S quick saves, ⇧⌘S saves as, T pins to the screen, O captures text, and the toolbar can translate too; after capturing, the screenshot flies to the bottom-right corner as a thumbnail you can drag into other apps

changes.text: 长截图：框选后按 S，在选区里上下滚动自动拼成一张；按空格自动滚动（需辅助功能授权）
changes.textEn: Scrolling Capture: press S after selecting and scroll up or down in the selection to stitch it into one image; press Space to auto-scroll (requires Accessibility access)

changes.text: 识字（默认 ⌥O）：框选后直接复制图中文字，有二维码或条码时复制它的内容，本机识别不联网
changes.textEn: Capture Text (⌥O by default): select an area to copy the text in it right away, or the content of a QR code or barcode if there is one, recognized on this Mac and never online

changes.text: 钉图：把截图钉在屏幕上当参考，不抢焦点，可拖动、缩放、调透明度，菜单栏里可隐藏或关闭全部
changes.textEn: Pin: pin a screenshot to the screen as a reference without taking focus; drag, zoom and adjust its opacity, and hide or close them all from the menu bar

changes.text: 常驻菜单栏，平时不占程序坞；快捷键都能改，菜单里标出当前快捷键，菜单开着时也能直接唤出；macOS 15.0 / 15.1 上只带 ⌥ 的默认快捷键注册不了，要换成带 ⌘ 或 ⌃ 的
changes.textEn: Lives in the menu bar and stays out of the Dock; every shortcut can be changed, the menu shows the current shortcuts, and shortcuts work even while the menu is open. On macOS 15.0 / 15.1, default shortcuts with only ⌥ can’t be registered and need to be changed to ones with ⌘ or ⌃

changes.text: 应用内更新：自动检查新版本（关于页可关），菜单栏一键下载、验签、替换并重新打开；只有第一次安装需要「仍要打开」
changes.textEn: In-app updates: checks for new versions automatically (can be turned off on the About page), and downloads, verifies, replaces and reopens with one click from the menu bar; “Open Anyway” is needed only for the first install

changes.text: 首次打开有欢迎引导：一键跳到辅助功能、屏幕录制授权，并试按快捷键；设置窗带搜索，可开「登录时自动打开」、查看各项授权
changes.textEn: First-run setup jumps straight to Accessibility and Screen Recording access and lets you try the shortcuts; the Settings window has search, “Open at login” and an overview of all permissions

changes.text: 外观可选跟随系统、浅色、深色；强调色默认跟随系统，也能从 8 种颜色里挑
changes.textEn: Appearance can follow the system or be light or dark; the accent color follows the system by default, or pick one of 8 colors

changes.text: 翻译服务的密钥只存在本机钥匙串里，剪贴板和翻译记录也只保存在本机；翻译时原文会发给所选的翻译服务（默认智谱）
changes.textEn: Translation service keys are stored only in this Mac’s keychain, and clipboard and translation records stay on this Mac; when translating, the source text is sent to the services you chose (Zhipu by default)

changes.text: 操作提示从刘海里长出来（没有刘海时是菜单栏下方的胶囊）；剪贴板、启动器和翻译浮窗呼出时不切换前台 App，关掉后键盘直接回到原处；支持减弱动态效果、降低透明度和旁白
changes.textEn: Notices grow out of the notch (or a capsule below the menu bar on displays without one); Clipboard, Launcher and the translation window open without switching the front app, and the keyboard goes right back when they close; supports Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency and VoiceOver

changes.text: 原创角色「探头」——扒在剪贴板卡片边上的小黑猫——做 App 图标和菜单栏图标
changes.textEn: An original character, “Peek”—a little black cat clinging to the edge of a clipboard card—is the app and menu bar icon
